description: Transfer of an organized electrical impulse across the heart to coordinate the contraction of cardiac muscles. The process begins with generation of an action potential (in the sinoatrial node (SA) in humans) and ends with a change in the rate, frequency, or extent of the contraction of the heart muscles.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: establishment or maintenance of monopolar cell polarity
description: Any cellular process that results in the specification, formation or maintenance of monopolar intracellular organization or cell growth patterns. Monopolar cell organization is directional organization along an axis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cell adhesion involved in heart morphogenesis
description: The attachment of a cell, either to another cell or to an underlying substrate such as the extracellular matrix, via cell adhesion molecules that contributes to the shaping of the heart.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of cell adhesion involved in heart morphogenesis
description: Any process that modulates the extent of cell adhesion contributing to the shaping of the heart.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: neural precursor cell proliferation
description: The multiplication or reproduction of neural precursor cells, resulting in the expansion of a cell population. A neural precursor cell is either a nervous system stem cell or a nervous system progenitor cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: Wnt protein secretion
description: The controlled release of a Wnt protein from a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of Wnt protein secretion
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the controlled release of a Wnt protein from a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of Wnt protein secretion
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the controlled release of a Wnt protein from a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: optic chiasma development
description: The developmental process pertaining to the progression of the optic chiasm from its initial formation to the mature structure. The process begins when the pathfinding of the axons of the developing optic nerve cause some axons to cross at the midline of the brain and ends when the axons are mature.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: apoptotic process involved in luteolysis
description: The apoptotic process that contributes to luteolysis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of triglyceride lipase activity
description: Any process that increases the activity of triglyceride lipase.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: behavioral response to acetic acid induced pain
description: Any process that results in a change in the behaviour of an organism as a result of an acetic acid pain stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: behavioral response to formalin induced pain
description: Any process that results in a change in the behaviour of an organism as a result of a formalin pain stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of testicular blood vessel morphogenesis
synonyms: negative regulation of testicular vasculature morphogenesis
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of blood vessel morphogenesis in the testicle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: testosterone biosynthetic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of testosterone, an androgen having 17beta-hydroxy and 3-oxo groups, together with unsaturation at C-4 C-5.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: determination of heart left/right asymmetry
description: Determination of the asymmetric location of the heart with respect to the left and right halves of the organism.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mammillothalamic axonal tract development
description: The progression of the mammillothalamic axonal tract, from its formation to the mature structure. The mammillothalamic tract is the collection of axons that connects the two major subdivisions of the diencephalon (hypothalamus and thalamus) and closes the diencephalic circuit.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mammary gland lobule development
description: The progression of the mammary gland lobule over time, from its formation to the mature structure. A mammary gland lobule is a small rounded projection of the mammary gland.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: inferior colliculus development
description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of the inferior colliculus over time, from its formation to the mature structure. The inferior colliculus (IC) (Latin, lower hill) is the principal midbrain nucleus of the auditory pathway and receives input from several more peripheral brainstem nuclei in the auditory pathway, as well as inputs from the auditory cortex. The inferior colliculus has three subdivisions: the central nucleus (CIC), a dorsal cortex (DCIC) by which it is surrounded, and an external cortex (ICX) which is located laterally.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cell migration in diencephalon
description: The orderly movement of a cell that will reside in the diencephalon.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: heart trabecula morphogenesis
description: The process of shaping a trabecula in the heart. A trabecula is a small, often microscopic, tissue element in the form of a small beam, strut or rod, which generally has a mechanical function. Trabecula are usually but not necessarily, composed of dense collagenous tissue.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: closure of optic fissure
description: The closure of the temporary ventral gap in the optic cup that contributes to its shaping.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: bone trabecula morphogenesis
description: The process of shaping a trabecula in bone. A trabecula is a tissue element in the form of a small beam, strut or rod.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular response to methionine
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a methionine stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular response to caloric restriction
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a of caloric restriction, insufficient food energy intake.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: establishment of skin barrier
synonyms: epithelial barrier development|establishment of epithelial barrier|skin barrier development
description: Establishment of the epithelial barrier, the functional barrier in the skin that limits its permeability.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: renal artery morphogenesis
description: The process in which the anatomical structure of a renal artery is generated and organized. Renal arteries supply the kidneys with blood.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endocardial cushion cell development
description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of an endocardial cushion cell over time, from its formation to the mature state.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endocardial cushion cell fate commitment
description: The commitment of a cell to an endocardial cushion cell fate and its capacity to differentiate into an endocardial cushion cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: connective tissue development
description: The progression of a connective tissue over time, from its formation to the mature structure.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: trophoblast cell migration
description: Trophoblast cell migration that is accomplished by extension and retraction of a pseudopodium. Trophoblast cells line the outside of the blastocyst.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: retrotrapezoid nucleus neuron differentiation
description: The process in which a relatively unspecialized cell acquires specialized features of a neuron whose cell body resides in the retrotrapezoid nucleus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: reproductive system development
description: The progression of the reproductive system over time from its formation to the mature structure. The reproductive system consists of the organs that function in reproduction.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to lysosome
description: A process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained in, a location within a lysosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of type B pancreatic cell proliferation
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of type B pancreatic cell proliferation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: T follicular helper cell differentiation
description: The process in which a relatively unspecialized T cell acquires specialized features of a mature T follicular helper cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: response to TNF agonist
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a TNF agonist stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: hematopoietic stem cell homeostasis
description: Any biological process involved in the maintenance of the steady-state number of hematopoietic stem cells within a population of cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: centriole elongation
description: The centrosome organization process by which a centriole increases in length as part of the process of replication.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to cilium
description: A process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained in, a location within a cilium.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: interleukin-34-mediated signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by interleukin-34 binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: myeloid cell development
description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of a myeloid cell over time, from its formation to the mature structure.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: monocyte proliferation
description: The expansion of a monocyte population by cell division.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: microglial cell proliferation
description: The expansion of a microglial cell population by cell division.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cilium disassembly
description: A cellular process that results in the breakdown of a cilium.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: acetylcholine secretion
description: The regulated release of acetylcholine by a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: gamma-aminobutyric acid secretion, neurotransmission
description: The regulated release of gamma-aminobutyric acid by a cell, in which the gamma-aminobutyric acid acts as a neurotransmitter.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: sympathetic ganglion development
description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of a sympathetic ganglion over time, from its formation to the mature structure.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cranial ganglion development
description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of a cranial ganglion over time, from its formation to the mature structure.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: trigeminal ganglion development
description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of a trigeminal ganglion over time, from its formation to the mature structure.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: axon development
description: The progression of an axon over time. Covers axonogenesis (de novo generation of an axon) and axon regeneration (regrowth), as well as processes pertaining to the progression of the axon over time (fasciculation and defasciculation).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: actin filament bundle organization
description: A process that results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of an actin filament bundle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: actin filament bundle retrograde transport
description: A process of actin filament bundle distribution that results in the arrangement of actin filament bundles from the periphery toward the interior of the cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: calcium ion transmembrane transport via high voltage-gated calcium channel
description: A process in which a calcium ion is transported from one side of a membrane to the other by means of a high voltage-gated calcium channel.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: colon epithelial cell migration
description: The orderly movement of a colonic epithelial cell from one site to another, often during the development of a multicellular organism.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: calcium activated phospholipid scrambling
description: The movement of a population of phospholipid molecules from one leaflet of the plasma membrane bilayer to the opposite leaflet as a result of a calcium stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: calcium activated phosphatidylserine scrambling
description: The movement of a population of phosphatidylserine molecules from one leaflet of the plasma membrane bilayer to the opposite leaflet as a result of a calcium stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: calcium activated phosphatidylcholine scrambling
description: The movement of a population of phosphatidylcholine molecules from one leaflet of the plasma membrane bilayer to the opposite leaflet as a result of a calcium stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mannose to fructose-6-phosphate catabolic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways in which mannose, the aldohexose manno-hexose, is converted to fructose-6-phosphate.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: miRNA transcription
synonyms: miRNA gene transcription|microRNA gene transcription|pri-miRNA transcription by RNA polymerase II|pri-miRNA transcription from RNA polymerase II promoter|primary miRNA gene transcription
description: The cellular synthesis of microRNA (miRNA) transcripts. MicroRNA genes are synthesized as primary (pri) miRNA transcripts and subsequently processed to produce the ~22nt miRNAs that function in gene regulation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: glycolytic process through fructose-6-phosphate
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a monosaccharide into pyruvate, occurring through a fructose-6-phosphate intermediate, with the concomitant production of ATP and NADH.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: glycolytic process through glucose-6-phosphate
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a carbohydrate into pyruvate, occurring through a glucose-6-phosphate intermediate, with the concomitant production of a small amount of ATP.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: canonical glycolysis
description: The glycolytic process that begins with the conversion of glucose to glucose-6-phosphate by glucokinase activity. Glycolytic processes are the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a carbohydrate into pyruvate, with the concomitant production of a small amount of ATP.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: pharyngeal arch artery morphogenesis
description: The process in which the anatomical structures of a pharyngeal arch artery is generated and organized. The pharyngeal arch arteries are a series of six paired embryological vascular structures, the development of which give rise to several major arteries, such as the stapedial artery, the middle meningeal artery, the internal carotid artery and the pulmonary artery.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of protein complex stability
description: Any process that affects the structure and integrity of a protein complex by altering the likelihood of its assembly or disassembly.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cytoskeleton-dependent cytokinesis
description: A cytokinesis that involves the function of a set of proteins that are part of the microfilament or microtubule cytoskeleton.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: chemoattraction of axon
description: The process in which a neuron growth cone is directed to a specific target site in response to an attractive chemical signal.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: chemorepulsion of axon
description: The process in which a neuron growth cone is directed to a specific target site in response to a repulsive chemical cue.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to CENP-A containing chromatin
description: Any process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained at, CENP-A containing chromatin.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of glutamate neurotransmitter secretion in response to membrane depolarization
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of glutamate secretion in response to membrane depolarization, where glutamate acts as a neurotransmitter.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial ribosome assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of the mitochondrial ribosome and of its subunits.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: spontaneous neurotransmitter secretion
description: Neurotransmitter secretion that occurs in the absence of the action of a secretagogue or a presynaptic action potential.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: evoked neurotransmitter secretion
description: Neurotransmitter secretion that occurs in the presence of the action of a secretagogue or a presynaptic action potential.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: chaperone-mediated autophagy
description: The autophagy process which begins when chaperones and co-chaperones recognize a target motif and unfold the substrate protein. The proteins are then transported to the lysosome where they are degraded.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: detoxification of hydrogen peroxide
description: Any process that reduces or removes the toxicity of hydrogen peroxide. These include transport of hydrogen peroxide away from sensitive areas and to compartments or complexes whose purpose is sequestration.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular detoxification of hydrogen peroxide
description: Any process that reduces or removes the toxicity of hydrogen peroxide in a cell. These include transport of hydrogen peroxide away from sensitive areas and to compartments or complexes whose purpose is sequestration.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein deglutarylation
description: The removal of a glutaryl group (CO-CH2-CH2-CH2-CO) from a residue in a peptide or protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: reticulophagy
synonyms: ER autophagy|ER degradation|ER-phagy|autophagy of the ER|autophagy of the endoplasmic reticulum|endoplasmic reticulum autophagy|endoplasmic reticulum degradation
description: The selective autohagy process in which parts of the endoplasmic reticulum are loaded into autophagosomes, delivered to the vacuole, and degraded in response to changing cellular conditions.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: anterior neural tube closure
description: The step in the formation of the neural tube, where the paired anterior neural folds are brought together and fuse at the dorsal midline.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: glycophagy
description: The selective degradation of glycogen by macroautophagy.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lipophagy
description: The selective degradation of lipid droplets by macroautophagy.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: type 2 mitophagy
synonyms: PRKN-mediated mitophagy in response to mitochondrial depolarization|Park2-mediated mitophagy in response to mitochondrial depolarization|parkin-mediated mitophagy in response to mitochondrial depolarization
description: The selective autophagy process in which a mitochondrion is degraded by macroautophagy in a process initiated by mitochondrial depolarization (mtDepo) followed by Parkin binding, and ubiquitination of outer membrane proteins, to remove potentially harm-inducing dysfunctional/damaged mitochondria.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: engulfment of target by autophagosome
description: The membrane invagination process by which an autophagosomal membrane surrounds an object that will be degraded by macroautophagy.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: leukotriene signaling pathway
description: A G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway initiated by leukotriene binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: late endosomal microautophagy
description: The autophagy process by which cytosolic proteins targeted for degradation are tagged with a chaperone and are directly transferred into and degraded in a late endosomal compartment.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein lipidation involved in autophagosome assembly
description: The protein lipidation process by which phosphatidylethanolamine is conjugated to a protein of the ATG8 family, leading to membrane insertion of the protein as a step in autophagosome assembly.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein targeting to lysosome involved in chaperone-mediated autophagy
description: The targeting of a protein to the lysosome process in which an input protein binds to a chaperone and subsequently to a lysosomal receptor.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: motor learning
description: Any process in which an organism acquires a novel neuromuscular action or movement as the result of experience.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: motor behavior
description: The specific neuromuscular movement of a single organism in response to external or internal stimuli.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: substrate localization to autophagosome
synonyms: substrate sequestration to autophagosome|substrate sequestration to phagophore
description: The localization process by which an autophagic substrate is delivered to a forming autophagosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of circulating fibrinogen levels
description: Any process that increases the quantity of fibrinogen circulating in the bloodstream.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: leukocyte adhesion to vascular endothelial cell
description: The attachment of a leukocyte to vascular endothelial cell via adhesion molecules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: antifungal innate immune response
description: An defense response against a fungus mediated through an innate immune response. An innate immune response is mediated by germline encoded components that directly recognize components of potential pathogens.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: CAMKK-AMPK signaling cascade
synonyms: stress-activated AMP-activated protein kinase signaling cascade
description: The series of molecular signals in which calmodulin-dependent protein kinase activity enabled by a CAMKK directly activates an AMPK. The cascade begins with calmodulin binding calcium which in turn binds CAMKK enabling its calmodulin-dependent protein kinase activity. The cascade ends with AMP-activated protein kinase activity.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: multivesicular body-lysosome fusion
synonyms: MVB-lysosome fusion|endosome-lysosome fusion|fusion of MVB to lysosome|fusion of multivesicular body to lysosome|late endosome-lysosome fusion
description: The organelle membrane fusion process in which the membrane of a multivesicular body fuses with a lysosome to create a hybrid organelle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: late endosome to lysosome transport via multivesicular body sorting pathway
description: The directed movement of substances from late endosomes to lysosomes by a pathway in which molecules are sorted into multivesicular bodies, which then fuse with the lysosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of lung blood pressure
synonyms: negative regulation of pulmonary blood pressure
description: The process that decreases the force with which blood travels through the lungs.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: response to caloric restriction
description: A change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a caloric restriction, insufficient food energy intake.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: xenobiotic transport across blood-nerve barrier
synonyms: drug transport across blood-nerve barrier|drug transport across perineurial barrier
description: The directed movement of a xenobiotic through the blood-nerve barrier.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: dense core granule priming
synonyms: LDCV priming|dense core vesicle priming|large dense-core vesicle priming
description: A process that converts unprimed dense core granules (DCVs) to a pool of primed vesicles that are capable of fusing with the plasma membrane (fusion-competent) and thereby releasing their contents. Priming typically occurs after docking.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: Golgi lumen acidification
description: Any process that reduces the pH of the Golgi lumen, corresponding to an increase in hydrogen ion concentration.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: telomeric DNA-containing double minutes formation
description: A telomere maintenance process that results in the formation of small fragments of circular extrachromosomal DNA elements which contain telomeric DNA. It is speculated that telomeric DNA-containing double minutes are formed through a recombination event between the telomere and chromosome-internal TTAGGG-like sequences. Telomeric DNA-containing double minutes appear as two closely positioned dots in metaphase.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: telomeric D-loop disassembly
description: A telomere loop disassembly process that results in the disassembly of telomeric D-loops. A telomeric D-loop is a three-stranded DNA displacement loop that forms at the site where the telomeric 3' single-stranded DNA overhang (formed of the repeat sequence TTAGGG in mammals) is tucked back inside the double-stranded component of telomeric DNA molecule, thus forming a t-loop or telomeric-loop and protecting the chromosome terminus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cytosolic ciliogenesis
description: The process in which an axoneme is exposed entirely or partially to the cytoplasm or by which the cytoplasmic portion is assembled or extended. Cytosolic ciliogenesis can occur following compartmentalized ciliogenesis, in which the cilium is formed within a compartment separated from the cytoplasm.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to tricellular tight junction
description: A process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained in, a location within a tricellular tight junction.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: neuropeptide processing
description: Any protein maturation process achieved by the cleavage of a peptide bond or bonds within a neuropeptide precursor. Processing leads to the attainment of the full functional capacity of the neuropeptide.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: antimicrobial humoral immune response mediated by antimicrobial peptide
synonyms: antimicrobial peptide-mediated antimicrobial humoral response|peptide-mediated antimicrobial humoral response
description: An immune response against microbes mediated by anti-microbial peptides in body fluid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: response to cholecystokinin
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a cholecystokinin stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of neuroblast migration
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of neuroblast migration.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endoplasmic reticulum stress-induced pre-emptive quality control
synonyms: ER pQC|ER stress-indiced pre-emptive quality control
description: The response to endoplasimic reticulum stress in which nascent proteins are degraded by attenuation of their translocation into the ER followed by rerouting to the cytosol without cleavage of the signal peptide, and subsequent degradation by the proteasome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: polarized secretion of basement membrane proteins in epithelium
description: The basement membrane constituent secretion in which there is a restriction or targeting of basement membrane proteins for controlled release on the basal side of polarized epithelium.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of hepatic stellate cell migration
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of hepatic stellate cell migration.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of hepatic stellate cell contraction
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of hepatic stellate cell contraction.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of anterograde axonal transport of mitochondrion
synonyms: positive regulation of anterograde axon transport of mitochondria
description: Any process that activates or increasesthe frequency, rate or extent of the directed movement of mitochondria along microtubules in axons away from the cell body and towards the presynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of mini excitatory postsynaptic potential
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of mini excitatory postsynaptic potential. Mini excitatory postsynaptic potential is a process that leads to a temporary increase in postsynaptic potential due to the flow of positively charged ions into the postsynaptic cell, induced by the spontaneous release of a single vesicle of an excitatory neurotransmitter into the synapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of mini excitatory postsynaptic potential
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of mini excitatory postsynaptic potential. Mini excitatory postsynaptic potential is a process that leads to a temporary increase in postsynaptic potential due to the flow of positively charged ions into the postsynaptic cell, induced by the spontaneous release of a single vesicle of an excitatory neurotransmitter into the synapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of astrocyte activation
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of astrocyte activation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of astrocyte activation
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of astrocyte activation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: autophagosome-lysosome fusion
description: The process in which autophagosomes, double-membraned vesicles containing cytoplasmic material, fuse with a vacuole (yeast) or lysosome (e.g. mammals and insects). In the case of yeast, inner membrane-bounded structures (autophagic bodies) appear in the vacuole. Fusion provides an acidic environment and digestive function to the interior of the autophagosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: autophagosome-endosome fusion
description: The process in which an autophagosome fuses with an endosome to create an intermediate autophagic organelle called amphisome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of growth plate cartilage chondrocyte proliferation
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of the multiplication or reproduction of chondrocytes in a growing endochondral bone, resulting in the expansion of a cell population.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: peptidyl-lysine propionylation
description: The propionylation of peptidyl-lysine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of erythrocyte enucleation
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of erythrocyte enucleation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to somatodendritic compartment
description: A process in which a protein is transported to or maintained in a location within the somatodendritic compartment.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: c-di-GMP signaling
synonyms: 3\|5\'-cyclic di-GMP signaling|cyclic di-(3\':5\')-guanosine monophosphate signaling|cyclic di-GMP signaling|cyclic diguanylate signaling
description: Any process that mediates the transfer of information from one cell to another using c-di-GMP as the signal.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of protein K48-linked ubiquitination
description: Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of K48-linked ubiquitination, a protein ubiquitination process in which a polymer of ubiquitin, formed by linkages between lysine residues at position 48 of the ubiquitin monomers, is added to a protein. K48-linked ubiquitination targets the substrate protein for degradation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: establishment of protein localization to plasma membrane
description: The directed movement of a protein to a specific location in a plasma membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: midbody abscission
description: The process by which the midbody, the cytoplasmic bridge that connects the two prospective daughter cells, is severed at the end of mitotic cytokinesis, resulting in two separate daughter cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: establishment of left/right asymmetry
description: The initial formation of the type asymmetry in an organism's body plan or part of an organism with respect to the left and right halves.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: articular cartilage development
description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of articular cartilage over time, from its formation to the mature structure.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: meiosis I cell cycle process
description: A process that contributes to the first meiotic division. The first meiotic division is the reductive division resulting in the separation of homologous chromosome pairs.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of cardiac endothelial to mesenchymal transition
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of cardiac endothelial to mesenchymal trnasition.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: secondary palate development
description: The biological process whose specific outcome is the progression of the secondary palate from an initial condition to its mature state. This process begins with the formation of the structure and ends with the mature structure. The secondary palate is the part of the palate formed from the fusion of the two palatine shelves, extensions of the maxillary prominences.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent catabolic process
description: Any process that stops or decreases the rate, frequency or extent of SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process, the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein or peptide by hydrolysis of its peptide bonds, initiated by the covalent attachment of ubiquitin, with ubiquitin-protein ligation catalyzed by an SCF (Skp1/Cul1/F-box protein) complex, and mediated by the proteasome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent catabolic process
description: Any process that starts or increases the rate, frequency or extent of SCF-dependent proteasomal ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process, the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein or peptide by hydrolysis of its peptide bonds, initiated by the covalent attachment of ubiquitin, with ubiquitin-protein ligation catalyzed by an SCF (Skp1/Cul1/F-box protein) complex, and mediated by the proteasome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of cytoplasmic stress granule assembly
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of cytoplasmic stress granule assembly, the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of proteins and RNA molecules to form a cytoplasmic stress granule.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of cytoplasmic stress granule assembly
synonyms: positive regulation of stress granule assembly
description: Any process that starts or increases the rate, frequency or extent of cytoplasmic stress granule assembly, the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of proteins and RNA molecules to form a cytoplasmic stress granule.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of cytoplasmic stress granule assembly
synonyms: negative regulation of stress granule assembly
description: Any process that stops or decreases the rate, frequency or extent of cytoplasmic stress granule assembly, the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of proteins and RNA molecules to form a cytoplasmic stress granule.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of mitotic sister chromatid segregation
description: Any process that starts or increases the frequency, rate or extent of sister chromatid segregation during mitosis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: sensory perception of hot stimulus
description: The series of events required for an organism to receive a hot temperature stimulus, convert it to a molecular signal, and recognize and characterize the signal.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of cardiac epithelial to mesenchymal transition
description: Any process that starts or increases the rate, frequency or extent of cardiac epithelial to mesenchymal transition, a transition where a cardiac epithelial cell loses apical/basolateral polarity, severs intercellular adhesive junctions, degrades basement membrane components and becomes a migratory mesenchymal cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of cardiac epithelial to mesenchymal transition
description: Any process that stops or decreases the rate, frequency or extent of cardiac epithelial to mesenchymal transition, a transition where a cardiac epithelial cell loses apical/basolateral polarity, severs intercellular adhesive junctions, degrades basement membrane components and becomes a migratory mesenchymal cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of taurine biosynthetic process
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of taurine biosynthesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: stomach development
description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of the stomach over time, from its formation to the mature structure. The stomach is an expanded region of the vertebrate alimentary tract that serves as a food storage compartment and digestive organ.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of programmed necrotic cell death
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of programmed necrotic cell death.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of programmed necrotic cell death
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of programmed necrotic cell death.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of programmed necrotic cell death
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of programmed necrotic cell death.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: zinc ion import into organelle
description: The directed import of zinc(2+) from the cytosol, across an organelle membrane, into the organelle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: fatty acid primary amide biosynthetic process
synonyms: FAPA biosynthesis|FAPA biosynthetic process|fatty acid amide biosynthesis
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of a fatty acid primary amide.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of L-glutamine biosynthetic process
description: Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of L-glutamine biosynthesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lutein catabolic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of lutein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: brexanolone metabolic process
synonyms: allopregnanolone metabolic process|allopregnanolone metabolism|allotetrahydroprogesterone metabolic process|allotetrahydroprogesterone metabolism|brexanolone metabolism
description: The chemical reactions and pathways by which living organisms transform brexanolone.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: R-loop processing
description: A DNA metabolic process that results in the disassembly of R-loops. R-loops are three-stranded nucleic acid structures consisitng of an RNA:DNA heteroduplex and a looped-out non-template strand. Aberrant formation and persistence of R-loops block transcription elongation and cause DNA damage. Mechanisms that resolve R-loops are essential for genome stability.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: radial spoke assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form the radial spoke, a protein complex that links the outer microtubule doublet of the ciliary or flagellum axoneme with the sheath that surrounds the central pair of microtubules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of lysosome size
description: Any process that modulates the size of a lysosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular response to chemical stress
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a chemical stimulus indicating the organism is under stress.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of pattern recognition receptor signaling pathway
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of a pattern recognition receptor signaling pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: platelet activating factor catabolic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of platelet activating factor, 2-O-acetyl-1-O-octadecyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: specification of axis polarity
description: The pattern specification process in which the polarity of a body or organ axis is established and maintained.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intracellular protein transmembrane transport
synonyms: intracellular membrane translocation of a protein|intracellular protein membrane transport|intracellular protein transport across a membrane
description: The directed movement of proteins in a cell, from one side of a membrane to another by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein-containing complex assembly
synonyms: cellular macromolecule complex assembly|cellular protein complex assembly|cellular protein-containing complex assembly|chaperone activity|macromolecular complex assembly|macromolecule complex assembly|protein complex assembly|protein complex formation
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of macromolecules to form a protein-containing complex.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein-DNA complex assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of proteins and DNA molecules to form a protein-DNA complex.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein-lipid complex assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of proteins and lipids to form a protein-lipid complex.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: neuron cellular homeostasis
description: The cellular homeostatic process that preserves a neuron in a stable, differentiated functional and structural state.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mRNA splicing, via endonucleolytic cleavage and ligation
description: Splicing of mRNA substrates via recognition of the folded RNA structure that brings the 5' and 3' splice sites into proximity and cleavage of the RNA at both the 3' and 5' splice sites by an endonucleolytic mechanism, followed by ligation of the exons.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway in response to endoplasmic reticulum stress
synonyms: ER stress-induced apoptosis|apoptosis in response to ER stress|apoptosis in response to endoplasmic reticulum stress|apoptosis triggered by ER stress|endoplasmic reticulum stress-induced apoptosis|intrinsic apoptotic signaling pathway induced by endoplasmic reticulum stress
description: The series of molecular signals in which an intracellular signal is conveyed to trigger the apoptotic death of a cell. The pathway is induced in response to a stimulus indicating endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, and ends when the execution phase of apoptosis is triggered. ER stress usually results from the accumulation of unfolded or misfolded proteins in the ER lumen.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: 'de novo' actin filament nucleation
synonyms: formin-mediated actin filament nucleation|unbranched actin filament nucleation
description: The actin nucleation process in which actin monomers combine in the absence of any existing actin filaments; elongation of the actin oligomer formed by nucleation leads to the formation of an unbranched filament.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: proton-transporting V-type ATPase complex assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a proton-transporting V-type ATPase complex, proton-transporting two-sector ATPase complex that couples ATP hydrolysis to the transport of protons across a concentration gradient.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase complex assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a vacuolar proton-transporting V-type ATPase complex, proton-transporting two-sector ATPase complex that couples ATP hydrolysis to the transport of protons across the vacuolar membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: clustering of voltage-gated calcium channels
synonyms: clustering of voltage gated calcium channels|clustering of voltage-dependent calcium channels|voltage-gated calcium channel clustering
description: The process in which voltage-gated calcium channels become localized together in high densities.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: tear secretion
description: The regulated release of the aqueous layer of the tear film from the lacrimal glands. Tears are the liquid product of a process of lacrimation to clean and lubricate the eyes. Tear fluid contains water, mucin, lipids, lysozyme, lactoferrin, lipocalin, lacritin, immunoglobulins, glucose, urea, sodium, and potassium.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis
description: Endocytosis of a protein that requires the substrate to be modified by ubiquitination. Several plasma membrane proteins, including cell surface permeases and some receptors, are targeted for internalization by endocytosis, and are thereafter delivered to the vacuole or lysosome, where they are degraded.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: glucagon secretion
description: The regulated release of glucagon from secretory granules in the A (alpha) cells of the pancreas (islets of Langerhans).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of glucagon secretion
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the regulated release of glucagon.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of glucagon secretion
synonyms: down regulation of glucagon secretion|down-regulation of glucagon secretion|downregulation of glucagon secretion|inhibition of glucagon secretion
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the regulated release of glucagon.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of glucagon secretion
synonyms: activation of glucagon secretion|stimulation of glucagon secretion|up regulation of glucagon secretion|up-regulation of glucagon secretion|upregulation of glucagon secretion
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the regulated release of glucagon.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial outer membrane translocase complex assembly
synonyms: TOM complex assembly|mitochondrion outer membrane translocase complex assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a mitochondrial outer membrane translocase complex.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: chemokine-mediated signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by a chemokine binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of chemokine-mediated signaling pathway
synonyms: negative regulation of chemokine-mediated signalling pathway
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of a chemokine-mediated signaling pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: interleukin-6-mediated signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by interleukin-6 binding to a receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of interleukin-6-mediated signaling pathway
synonyms: negative regulation of IL-6-mediated signaling pathway|negative regulation of interleukin-6-mediated signalling pathway
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of an interleukin-6-mediated signaling pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of interleukin-6-mediated signaling pathway
synonyms: positive regulation of IL-6-mediated signaling pathway|positive regulation of interleukin-6-mediated signalling pathway
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of an interleukin-6-mediated signaling pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: interleukin-27-mediated signaling pathway
synonyms: IL-27-mediated signaling pathway|IL27RA/IL6ST signaling pathway|interleukin-27-mediated signalling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by interleukin-27 binding to a receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: ciliary neurotrophic factor-mediated signaling pathway
synonyms: CNTF-mediated signaling pathway|ciliary neurotrophic factor-mediated signalling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by the binding of a ciliary neurotrophic factor (CNTF) to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial translational initiation
description: The process preceding formation of the peptide bond between the first two amino acids of a protein in a mitochondrion. This includes the formation of a complex of the ribosome, mRNA, and an initiation complex that contains the first aminoacyl-tRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial translational elongation
description: The successive addition of amino acid residues to a nascent polypeptide chain during protein biosynthesis in a mitochondrion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial translational termination
description: The process resulting in the release of a polypeptide chain from the ribosome in a mitochondrion, usually in response to a termination codon (note that mitochondria use variants of the universal genetic code that differ between different taxa).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of mitochondrial translation
synonyms: regulation of mitochondrial protein anabolism|regulation of mitochondrial protein biosynthesis|regulation of mitochondrial protein formation|regulation of mitochondrial protein synthesis
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of proteins by the translation of mRNA in a mitochondrion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of mitochondrial translation
synonyms: positive regulation of mitochondrial protein anabolism|positive regulation of mitochondrial protein biosynthesis|positive regulation of mitochondrial protein formation|positive regulation of mitochondrial protein synthesis
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of proteins by the translation of mRNA in a mitochondrion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: response to UV-A
synonyms: response to UV-A light stimulus|response to UV-A radiation stimulus|response to UVA light stimulus|response to UVA radiation stimulus
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a UV-A radiation stimulus. UV-A radiation (UV-A light) spans the wavelengths 315 to 400 nm.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial alanyl-tRNA aminoacylation
description: The process of coupling alanine to alanyl-tRNA in a mitochondrion, catalyzed by alanyl-tRNA synthetase. In tRNA aminoacylation, the amino acid is first activated by linkage to AMP and then transferred to either the 2'- or the 3'-hydroxyl group of the 3'-adenosine residue of the tRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial asparaginyl-tRNA aminoacylation
description: The process of coupling asparagine to asparaginyl-tRNA in a mitochondrion, catalyzed by asparaginyl-tRNA synthetase. In tRNA aminoacylation, the amino acid is first activated by linkage to AMP and then transferred to either the 2'- or the 3'-hydroxyl group of the 3'-adenosine residue of the tRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial glycyl-tRNA aminoacylation
description: The process of coupling glycine to glycyl-tRNA in a mitochondrion, catalyzed by glycyl-tRNA synthetase. In tRNA aminoacylation, the amino acid is first activated by linkage to AMP and then transferred to either the 2'- or the 3'-hydroxyl group of the 3'-adenosine residue of the tRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial seryl-tRNA aminoacylation
description: The process of coupling serine to seryl-tRNA in a mitochondrion, catalyzed by seryl-tRNA synthetase. In tRNA aminoacylation, the amino acid is first activated by linkage to AMP and then transferred to either the 2'- or the 3'-hydroxyl group of the 3'-adenosine residue of the tRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of adiponectin secretion
synonyms: down regulation of adiponectin secretion|down-regulation of adiponectin secretion|downregulation of adiponectin secretion|inhibition of adiponectin secretion
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the regulated release of adiponectin from a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of adiponectin secretion
synonyms: activation of adiponectin secretion|stimulation of adiponectin secretion|up regulation of adiponectin secretion|up-regulation of adiponectin secretion|upregulation of adiponectin secretion
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the regulated release of adiponectin from a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: enamel mineralization
description: The process in which calcium salts, mainly carbonated hydroxyapatite, are deposited in tooth enamel.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of biomineral tissue development
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of biomineral tissue development, the formation of hard tissues that consist mainly of inorganic compounds.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of biomineral tissue development
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of biomineral tissue development, the formation of hard tissues that consist mainly of inorganic compounds.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of tooth mineralization
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of tooth mineralization, the deposition of calcium salts in tooth structures.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of tooth mineralization
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of tooth mineralization, the deposition of calcium salts in tooth structures.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of enamel mineralization
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of enamel mineralization, the deposition of calcium salts in tooth enamel.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: D-serine biosynthetic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of D-serine, the D-enantiomer of serine, i.e. (2R)-2-amino-3-hydroxypropanoic acid. D-serine is often formed by racemization of L-serine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial tryptophanyl-tRNA aminoacylation
description: The process of coupling tryptophan to tryptophanyl-tRNA in a mitochondrion, catalyzed by tryptophanyl-tRNA synthetase. In tRNA aminoacylation, the amino acid is first activated by linkage to AMP and then transferred to either the 2'- or the 3'-hydroxyl group of the 3'-adenosine residue of the tRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: chromosome organization involved in meiotic cell cycle
synonyms: chromosome organisation involved in meiosis|meiotic chromosome organization
description: A process of chromosome organization that is involved in a meiotic cell cycle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: synaptonemal complex organization
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a synaptonemal complex. A synaptonemal complex is a proteinaceous scaffold formed between homologous chromosomes during meiosis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: meiotic attachment of telomere to nuclear envelope
synonyms: attachment of telomeres to nuclear envelope|attachment of telomeric chromatin to nuclear envelope
description: The meiotic cell cycle process in which physical connections are formed between telomeric heterochromatin and the nuclear envelope, facilitating bouquet formation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to chromosome, telomeric region
synonyms: protein localisation to chromosome|telomeric region|protein localization to telomere
description: Any process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained at, the telomeric region of a chromosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: establishment of protein localization to telomere
synonyms: establishment of protein localisation to telomere|establishment of protein localization to chromosome|telomeric region
description: The directed movement of a protein to a specific location in the telomeric region of a chromosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of establishment of protein localization
synonyms: regulation of establishment of protein localisation
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the directed movement of a protein to a specific location.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of establishment of protein localization to chromosome
synonyms: regulation of establishment of protein localisation to chromosome
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the directed movement of a protein to a specific location on a chromosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of establishment of protein localization to telomere
synonyms: regulation of establishment of protein localisation to telomere
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the directed movement of a protein to a specific location in the telomeric region of a chromosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein trimerization
synonyms: protein trimer assembly|protein trimer biosynthesis|protein trimer biosynthetic process|protein trimer formation
description: The formation of a protein trimer, a macromolecular structure consisting of three noncovalently associated identical or nonidentical subunits.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein homotrimerization
synonyms: protein homotrimer assembly|protein homotrimer biosynthesis|protein homotrimer biosynthetic process|protein homotrimer formation
description: The formation of a protein homotrimer, a macromolecular structure consisting of three noncovalently associated identical subunits.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein poly-ADP-ribosylation
synonyms: addition of poly-ADP-ribose to protein|poly(ADP-ribose) addition to protein|protein amino acid poly-ADP-ribosylation|protein poly(ADP-ribose) metabolism|protein poly(ADP-ribose) synthesis
description: The transfer of multiple ADP-ribose residues from NAD to a protein amino acid, forming a poly(ADP-ribose) chain.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein auto-ADP-ribosylation
description: The ADP-ribosylation by a protein of one or more of its own amino acid residues, or residues on an identical protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lymphocyte apoptotic process
description: Any apoptotic process in a lymphocyte, a leukocyte commonly found in the blood and lymph that has the characteristics of a large nucleus, a neutral staining cytoplasm, and prominent heterochromatin.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of lymphocyte apoptotic process
description: Any process that modulates the occurrence or rate of lymphocyte death by apoptotic process.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: T cell apoptotic process
synonyms: T cell apoptosis|T lymphocyte apoptosis|T-cell apoptosis|T-lymphocyte apoptosis|programmed cell death of T cells by apoptosis
description: Any apoptotic process in a T cell, a type of lymphocyte whose defining characteristic is the expression of a T cell receptor complex.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of T cell apoptotic process
synonyms: regulation of T cell apoptosis|regulation of T lymphocyte apoptosis|regulation of T-cell apoptosis|regulation of T-lymphocyte apoptosis|regulation of programmed cell death of T cells by apoptosis
description: Any process that modulates the occurrence or rate of T cell death by apoptotic process.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of T cell apoptotic process
synonyms: down regulation of T cell apoptosis|down-regulation of T cell apoptosis|downregulation of T cell apoptosis|inhibition of T cell apoptosis|negative regulation of T cell apoptosis|negative regulation of T lymphocyte apoptosis|negative regulation of T-cell apoptosis|negative regulation of T-lymphocyte apoptosis|negative regulation of programmed cell death of T cells by apoptosis
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of T cell death by apoptotic process.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of T cell apoptotic process
synonyms: activation of T cell apoptosis|positive regulation of T cell apoptosis|positive regulation of T lymphocyte apoptosis|positive regulation of T-cell apoptosis|positive regulation of T-lymphocyte apoptosis|positive regulation of programmed cell death of T cells by apoptosis|stimulation of T cell apoptosis|up regulation of T cell apoptosis|up-regulation of T cell apoptosis|upregulation of T cell apoptosis
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of T cell death by apoptotic process.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of activation-induced cell death of T cells
synonyms: regulation of AICD|regulation of activated T cell apoptosis|regulation of activation-induced cell death of T lymphocytes|regulation of activation-induced cell death of T-cells|regulation of activation-induced cell death of T-lymphocytes|regulation of antigen-driven apoptosis
description: Any process that modulates the occurrence or rate of activation-induced cell death of T cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of activation-induced cell death of T cells
synonyms: down regulation of activation-induced cell death of T cells|down-regulation of activation-induced cell death of T cells|downregulation of activation-induced cell death of T cells|inhibition of activation-induced cell death of T cells|negative regulation of AICD|negative regulation of activated T cell apoptosis|negative regulation of activation-induced cell death of T lymphocytes|negative regulation of activation-induced cell death of T-cells|negative regulation of activation-induced cell death of T-lymphocytes|negative regulation of antigen-driven apoptosis
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of activation-induced cell death of T cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of activated T cell autonomous cell death
synonyms: activation of activated T cell autonomous cell death|positive regulation of ACAD|positive regulation of activated T cell apoptosis|positive regulation of activated T lymphocyte autonomous cell death|positive regulation of activated T-cell autonomous cell death|positive regulation of activated T-lymphocyte autonomous cell death|positive regulation of activated cell autonomous cell death|stimulation of activated T cell autonomous cell death|up regulation of activated T cell autonomous cell death|up-regulation of activated T cell autonomous cell death|upregulation of activated T cell autonomous cell death
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of activated T cell autonomous cell death.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: thymocyte apoptotic process
description: Any apoptotic process in a thymocyte, an immature T cell located in the thymus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of thymocyte apoptotic process
synonyms: down regulation of thymocyte apoptosis|down-regulation of thymocyte apoptosis|downregulation of thymocyte apoptosis|inhibition of thymocyte apoptosis|negative regulation of immature T cell apoptosis|negative regulation of thymocyte apoptosis
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of thymocyte death by apoptotic process.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of thymocyte apoptotic process
synonyms: activation of thymocyte apoptosis|positive regulation of immature T cell apoptosis|positive regulation of thymocyte apoptosis|stimulation of thymocyte apoptosis|up regulation of thymocyte apoptosis|up-regulation of thymocyte apoptosis|upregulation of thymocyte apoptosis
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of thymocyte death by apoptotic process.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of natural killer cell apoptotic process
synonyms: regulation of NK cell apoptosis|regulation of natural killer cell apoptosis
description: Any process that modulates the occurrence or rate of natural killer cell death by apoptotic process.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: actin-mediated cell contraction
description: The actin filament-based process in which cytoplasmic actin filaments slide past one another resulting in contraction of all or part of the cell body.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: somatostatin secretion
description: The regulated release of somatostatin from secretory granules in the D cells of the pancreas.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mucus secretion
description: The regulated release of mucus by the mucosa. Mucus is a viscous slimy secretion consisting of mucins and various inorganic salts dissolved in water, with suspended epithelial cells and leukocytes. The mucosa, or mucous membrane, is the membrane covered with epithelium that lines the tubular organs of the body. Mucins are carbohydrate-rich glycoproteins that have a lubricating and protective function.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of mucus secretion
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the regulated release of mucus from a cell or a tissue.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: peptidyl-serine dephosphorylation
description: The removal of phosphoric residues from peptidyl-O-phospho-L-serine to form peptidyl-serine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: necroptotic process
synonyms: PARP-dependent cell death|RIPK1-mediated regulated necrosis|TNF-induced necroptosis|activation of necroptosis|activation of necroptosis by extracellular signals|activation of necroptosis in response to extracellular signals|activation of necroptosis of activated-T cells|establishment of necroptosis|establishment of necroptosis of activated-T cells|extracellular signal-induced necroptosis|induction of necroptosis|induction of necroptosis by extracellular signals|induction of necroptosis of activated-T cells|necroptosis|parthanatos|programmed necrosis|programmed necrotic cell death
description: A programmed necrotic cell death process which begins when a cell receives a signal (e.g. a ligand binding to a death receptor or to a Toll-like receptor), and proceeds through a series of biochemical events (signaling pathways), characterized by activation of receptor-interacting serine/threonine-protein kinase 1 and/or 3 (RIPK1/3, also called RIP1/3) and by critical dependence on mixed lineage kinase domain-like (MLKL), and which typically lead to common morphological features of necrotic cell death. The process ends when the cell has died. The process is divided into a signaling phase, and an execution phase, which is triggered by the former.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cornification
description: A type of programmed cell death that occurs in the epidermis, morphologically and biochemically distinct from apoptosis. It leads to the formation of corneocytes, i.e. dead keratinocytes containing an amalgam of specific proteins (e.g., keratin, loricrin, SPR and involucrin) and lipids (e.g., fatty acids and ceramides), which are necessary for the function of the cornified skin layer (mechanical resistance, elasticity, water repellence and structural stability).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: pyroptotic inflammatory response
description: A gasdermin-dependent inflammatory response that is associated with the generation of pyrogenic mediators such as IL-1beta and IL-18. Gasdermins are activated by caspase-1 or caspase-4/11, or by certain granzymes. In some, but not all cells, it can lead to pyroptotic programmed cell death.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: extracellular matrix constituent secretion
description: The controlled release of molecules that form the extracellular matrix, including carbohydrates and glycoproteins by a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: pigment cell development
description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of a pigment cell over time, from its formation to the mature structure. Cell development does not include the steps involved in committing a cell to a pigment cell fate.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: axonemal dynein complex assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form an axonemal dynein complex, a dynein complex found in eukaryotic cilia and flagella, in which the motor domain heads interact with adjacent microtubules to generate a sliding force which is converted to a bending motion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: N-acylethanolamine metabolic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways involving N-acylethanolamines. An N-acylethanolamine is an ethanolamine substituted at nitrogen by an acyl group.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine metabolic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways involving N-acylphosphatidylethanolamines. An N-acylphosphatidylethanolamine is a phosphatidylethanolamine substituted at nitrogen by an acyl group.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: renal absorption
description: A renal system process in which water, ions, glucose and proteins are taken up from the collecting ducts, glomerulus and proximal and distal loops of the nephron. In non-mammalian species, absorption may occur in related structures (e.g. protein absorption is observed in nephrocytes in Drosophila, see PMID:23264686).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: renal sodium ion absorption
synonyms: nephron sodium ion absorption|renal sodium ion reabsorption
description: A renal system process in which sodium ions are taken up from the collecting ducts and proximal and distal loops of the nephron. In non-mammalian species, absorption may occur in related structures.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: renal water absorption
description: A renal system process in which water is taken up from the collecting ducts and proximal and distal loops of the nephron. In non-mammalian species, absorption may occur in related structures.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium ion transport
description: The directed movement of calcium ions (Ca2+) into, out of or within the sarcoplasmic reticulum.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular response to hydrogen peroxide
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) stimulus.

description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a cGMP (cyclic GMP, guanosine 3',5'-cyclophosphate) stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lens fiber cell differentiation
description: The process in which a relatively unspecialized cell acquires specialized features of a lens fiber cell, any of the elongated, tightly packed cells that make up the bulk of the mature lens in the camera-type eye. The cytoplasm of a lens fiber cell is devoid of most intracellular organelles including the cell nucleus, and contains primarily crystallins, a group of water-soluble proteins expressed in vary large quantities.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lens fiber cell development
description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of a lens fiber cell over time, from its formation to the mature structure. Cell development does not include the steps involved in committing a cell to a lens fiber cell fate. A lens fiber cell is any of the elongated, tightly packed cells that make up the bulk of the mature lens in a camera-type eye.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lens fiber cell morphogenesis
synonyms: elongation of lens fiber cell|lens fiber cell morphogenesis during differentiation|lens fibre cell morphogenesis
description: The process in which the structures of a lens fiber cell are generated and organized. This process occurs while the initially relatively unspecialized cell is acquiring the specialized features of a lens fiber cell. A lens fiber cell is any of the elongated, tightly packed cells that make up the bulk of the mature lens in a camera-type eye.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: G1 to G0 transition

description: A cell cycle arrest process that results in arrest during G1 phase, whereupon the cell enters a specialized resting state known as G0 or quiescence.

description: A cell cycle arrest process that results in arrest during G1 phase, whereupon the cell enters G0 phase, in the context of cell differentiation.

label: BiologicalProcess

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of G0 to G1 transition
description: A cell cycle process that activates or increases the rate or extent of the transition from the G0 quiescent state to the G1 phase.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: thyroid hormone transport
description: The directed movement of thyroid hormone into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: triglyceride homeostasis
description: Any process involved in the maintenance of an internal steady state of triglyceride within an organism or cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: brown fat cell proliferation
synonyms: brown adipocyte proliferation|brown adipose cell proliferation
description: The multiplication or reproduction of brown fat cells by cell division, resulting in the expansion of their population. A brown fat cell is a fat cell found the thermogenic form of adipose tissue found in newborns of many species.

label: BiologicalProcess

description: The multiplication or reproduction of white fat cells by cell division, resulting in the expansion of their population.

label: BiologicalProcess

description: A process involved in the controlled movement of a bacterial cell powered by the continuous polymerization of actin at one pole of the cell.

label: BiologicalProcess

description: The process in which a relatively unspecialized cell acquires the specialized features of a hepatocyte. A hepatocyte is specialized epithelial cell that is organized into interconnected plates called lobules, and is the main structural component of the liver.

label: BiologicalProcess

The cascade can also contain an additional tier: the upstream MAP4K. The kinases in each tier phosphorylate and activate the kinases in the downstream tier. The ERK5 cascade is activated by stress, mitogens, and by G protein-coupled receptors, and results in cellular responses such as cell growth, cell differentiation and development.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: DNA cytosine deamination
description: The removal of an amino group from a cytosine residue in DNA, forming a uracil residue.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: Harderian gland development
description: The process whose specific outcome is the progression of the Harderian gland over time, from its formation to the mature structure. The Harderian gland is an anterior orbital structure usually associated with the nictitating membrane, and produces and secretes a variety of substances to the eye, depending upon the species.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: detection of lipoteichoic acid
description: The series of events in which a lipoteichoic acid stimulus is received by a cell and converted into a molecular signal; lipoteichoic acid is a major component of the cell wall of gram-positive bacteria and typically consists of a chain of glycerol-phosphate repeating units linked to a glycolipid anchor.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular response to cold
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a cold stimulus, a temperature stimulus below the optimal temperature for that organism.

label: BiologicalProcess

label: BiologicalProcess

synonyms: positive regulation of NOD1 signaling pathway|positive regulation of nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain containing 1 signalling pathway

synonyms: negative regulation of NOD2 signaling pathway|negative regulation of nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain containing 2 signalling pathway
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate, or extent of the nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain containing 2 (NOD2) pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain containing 2 signaling pathway
synonyms: positive regulation of NOD2 signaling pathway|positive regulation of nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain containing 2 signalling pathway
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate, or extent of the nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain containing 2 (NOD2) pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess

description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation.

label: BiologicalProcess

synonyms: negative regulation of oligodendrocyte precursor proliferation

label: BiologicalProcess

label: BiologicalProcess
