label: BiologicalProcess
name: symbiont-mediated disruption of host cell PML body
synonyms: catabolism by symbiont of host cell PML body|degradation by symbiont of host cell PML body|disassembly by symbiont of host cell PML NB|disassembly by symbiont of host cell PML body|disassembly by symbiont of host cell PML body during symbiotic interaction|disassembly by symbiont of host cell PML nuclear body|disruption by symbiont of host cell PML body
description: The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of the host PML body. A PML body is a nuclear body that reacts against SP100 auto-antibodies (PML = promyelocytic leukemia). The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: entry of viral genome into host nucleus through nuclear pore complex via importin
synonyms: entry of viral genome into host nucleus via cellular importin transport through the nuclear pore complex
description: Viral penetration into the host nucleus where the viral genome passes through the nuclear pore complex (NPC) using the cellular importin transport machinery.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endocytosis involved in viral entry into host cell
synonyms: viral entry into host cell via endocytosis|viral penetration via endocytosis followed by endosome disruption|virus endocytosis by host
description: Any endocytosis that is involved in the uptake of a virus into a host cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: clathrin-dependent endocytosis of virus by host cell
synonyms: clathrin-mediated endocytosis of virus by host cell|viral entry into host cell via clathrin-mediated endocytosis|viral entry into host cell via clathrin-mediated endocytosis followed by endosome lysis|viral penetration via clathrin-mediated endocytosis
description: Any clathrin-mediated endocytosis that is involved in the uptake of a virus into a host cell. Begins by invagination of a specific region of the host cell plasma membrane around the bound virus to form a clathrin-coated pit, which then pinches off to form a clathrin-coated endocytic vesicle containing the virus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: IRES-dependent viral translational initiation
description: Process by which viral mRNA translation is initiated, where a domain in the 5' untranslated region (UTR) of the viral mRNA called an internal ribosome entry site (IRES) binds the host 43S preinitiation complex, circumventing regular cap-dependent translation initiation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: viral translational termination-reinitiation
synonyms: termination reinitiation involved in viral translation|viral translation involving termination re-initiation|viral translation involving termination-reinitiation|viral translation involving translational stop-start
description: A process which occurs as part of viral mRNA translation which allows expression of a downstream open reading frame (ORF) in a dicistronic mRNA. In this process, ribosomes translate the upstream ORF but following termination, a proportion of 40S subunits remain tethered to the mRNA and go on to re-initiate translation at the start codon of the downstream ORF.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: establishment of integrated proviral latency
description: A process by which the virus integrates into the host genome and establishes as a stable provirus or prophage.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intracellular transport of virus
synonyms: egress of virus within host cell|intracellular transport of viral material|intracellular virion transport|movement of virus within host cell|viral egress|viral genome transport in host cell
description: The directed movement of a virus, or part of a virus, within the host cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: CAAX-box protein maturation
description: A series of specific posttranslational modifications to the CAAX box region of CAAX box proteins. CAAX box proteins are eukaryotic proteins that contain a CAAX motif where the C is a cysteine, the two A residues are aliphatic amino acids and the X can be one of several amino acids. The CAAX-box proteins undergo three sequential, enzymatic, post-translational modifications essential to their targeting: First, the proteins are prenylated by one of two prenyltransferases called farnesyltransferase and geranylgeranyltransferase-I. Prenylation results in the covalent attachment of either farnesyl or geranylgeranyl isoprenoid groups to the cysteine in the CAAX box motif. Prenylation is followed by proteolytic removal of the last three amino acids of the protein (AAX). Finally, the newly exposed carboxylate group of the isoprenylcysteine is methylated by an ER-associated prenyl-dependent carboxylmethyltransferase.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: AMP transport
description: The directed movement of AMP, adenosine monophosphate, into, out of or within a cell, or between cells, by means of some agent such as a transporter or pore.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: proteasome core complex assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a mature, active 20S proteasome core particle complex that does not contain any regulatory particles.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of cellular response to stress
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of a cellular response to stress. Cellular response to stress is a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus indicating the organism is under stress. The stress is usually, but not necessarily, exogenous (e.g. temperature, humidity, ionizing radiation).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intracellular amino acid homeostasis
synonyms: amino acid homeostasis|cellular amino acid homeostasis
description: A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of amino acids within a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of fertilization
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of fertilization. Fertilization is the union of gametes of opposite sexes during the process of sexual reproduction to form a zygote. It involves the fusion of the gametic nuclei (karyogamy) and cytoplasm (plasmogamy).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of nitric oxide metabolic process
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways involving nitric oxide, nitrogen monoxide (NO), a colorless gas only slightly soluble in water.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: hydrogen peroxide transmembrane transport
description: The process in which H2O2 is transported across a membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: response to phenylpropanoid
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as the result of a phenylpropanoid stimulus. The process begins with detection of the stimulus and ends with a change in state or activity or the cell or organism. A phenylpropanoid is any of secondary metabolites with structures based on a phenylpropane skeleton. The class includes phenylpropanoid esters, flavonoids, anthocyanins, coumarins and many small phenolic molecules. Phenylpropanoids are also precursors of lignin.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: entry into host cell by a symbiont-containing vacuole
synonyms: symbiont entry into host cell forming a parasitophorous vacuole|symbiont entry into host cell forming a pathogen-containing vacuole|symbiont entry into host cell forming a symbiont-containing vacuole
description: The invasion by a symbiont of a cell of a host organism, forming a vacuole in which the symbiont resides. The vacuole membrane is formed from lipids and proteins derived from both host and symbiont. Begins when the symbiont attaches on to the host cell membrane which invaginates and deepens as the symbiont enters, and ends when the host cell membrane closes behind the newly-formed vacuole.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein K6-linked ubiquitination
description: A protein ubiquitination process in which a polymer of ubiquitin, formed by linkages between lysine residues at position 6 of the ubiquitin monomers, is added to a protein. K6-linked ubiquitination is involved in DNA repair.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: extracellular matrix assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of the extracellular matrix.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cardiac muscle cell action potential
description: An action potential that occurs in a cardiac muscle cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cardiac muscle cell action potential involved in contraction
description: An action potential that occurs in a cardiac muscle cell and is involved in its contraction.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cardiac muscle cell contraction
description: The actin filament-based process in which cytoplasmic actin filaments slide past one another resulting in contraction of a cardiac muscle cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of cardiac muscle cell contraction
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of cardiac muscle cell contraction.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: ventricular cardiac muscle cell action potential
description: An action potential that occurs in a ventricular cardiac muscle cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: membrane repolarization
description: The process in which ions are transported across a membrane such that the membrane potential changes in the repolarizing direction, toward the steady state potential. For example, the repolarization during an action potential is from a positive membrane potential towards a negative resting potential.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: membrane depolarization during action potential
description: The process in which membrane potential changes in the depolarizing direction from the negative resting potential towards the positive membrane potential that will be the peak of the action potential.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: membrane repolarization during action potential
description: The process in which ions are transported across a membrane such that the membrane potential changes in the direction from the positive membrane potential at the peak of the action potential towards the negative resting potential.

label: BiologicalProcess

description: A phospholipase C-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway initiated by angiotensin binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

label: BiologicalProcess

description: A G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway initiated by endothelin binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway involved in heart process
synonyms: G-protein coupled receptor signaling pathway involved in heart process|G-protein coupled receptor signalling pathway involved in heart process|GPCR signaling pathway involved in cardiac process|GPCR signaling pathway involved in heart process
description: An G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway which contributes to a circulatory system process carried out by the heart.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: L-histidine transmembrane export from vacuole
description: The directed movement of L-histidine out of the vacuole, across the vacuolar membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: L-histidine transmembrane transport
description: The directed movement of L-histidine across a membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: amino acid import across plasma membrane
synonyms: L-amino acid import|L-amino acid uptake|amino acid import into cell|amino acid transmembrane import
description: The directed movement of an amino acid from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: primitive streak formation
description: The developmental process pertaining to the initial formation of the primitive streak from unspecified parts. The primitive streak is a ridge of cells running along the midline of the embryo where the mesoderm ingresses. It defines the anterior-posterior axis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of neutrophil chemotaxis
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of neutrophil chemotaxis. Neutrophil chemotaxis is the directed movement of a neutrophil cell, the most numerous polymorphonuclear leukocyte found in the blood, in response to an external stimulus, usually an infection or wounding.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of neutrophil chemotaxis
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate, or extent of neutrophil chemotaxis. Neutrophil chemotaxis is the directed movement of a neutrophil cell, the most numerous polymorphonuclear leukocyte found in the blood, in response to an external stimulus, usually an infection or wounding.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of neutrophil chemotaxis
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate, or extent of neutrophil chemotaxis. Neutrophil chemotaxis is the directed movement of a neutrophil cell, the most numerous polymorphonuclear leukocyte found in the blood, in response to an external stimulus, usually an infection or wounding.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of monocyte chemotaxis
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of monocyte chemotaxis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of monocyte chemotaxis
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate, or extent of monocyte chemotaxis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of monocyte chemotaxis
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate, or extent of monocyte chemotaxis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of steroid hormone biosynthetic process
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of steroid hormones,compounds with a 1, 2, cyclopentanoperhydrophenanthrene nucleus that act as hormones.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of chaperone-mediated protein complex assembly
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate, or extent of chaperone-mediated protein complex assembly. Chaperone-mediated protein complex assembly is the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a protein complex, mediated by chaperone molecules that do not form part of the finished complex.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of protein kinase C signaling
synonyms: regulation of protein kinase C signaling cascade|regulation of protein kinase C signalling cascade
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of a series of reactions, mediated by the intracellular serine/threonine kinase protein kinase C, which occurs as a result of a single trigger reaction or compound.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of protein kinase C signaling
synonyms: positive regulation of protein kinase C signaling cascade|positive regulation of protein kinase C signalling cascade
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate, or extent of a series of reactions, mediated by the intracellular serine/threonine kinase protein kinase C, which occurs as a result of a single trigger reaction or compound.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of protein kinase C signaling
synonyms: negative regulation of protein kinase C signaling cascade|negative regulation of protein kinase C signalling cascade
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate, or extent of a series of reactions, mediated by the intracellular serine/threonine kinase protein kinase C, which occurs as a result of a single trigger reaction or compound.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: tubulin deacetylation
description: The removal of an acetyl group from tubulin. An acetyl group is CH3CO-, derived from acetic [ethanoic] acid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of tubulin deacetylation
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of tubulin deacetylation. Tubulin deacetylation is the removal of an acetyl group from a protein amino acid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of deacetylase activity
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of deacetylase activity, the catalysis of the hydrolysis of an acetyl group or groups from a substrate molecule.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of cell migration involved in sprouting angiogenesis
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of cell migration involved in sprouting angiogenesis. Cell migration involved in sprouting angiogenesis is the orderly movement of endothelial cells into the extracellular matrix in order to form new blood vessels contributing to the process of sprouting angiogenesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of cell migration involved in sprouting angiogenesis
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of cell migration involved in sprouting angiogenesis. Cell migration involved in sprouting angiogenesis is the orderly movement of endothelial cells into the extracellular matrix in order to form new blood vessels contributing to the process of sprouting angiogenesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of microtubule nucleation
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of microtubule nucleation. Microtubule nucleation is the 'de novo' formation of a microtubule, in which tubulin heterodimers form metastable oligomeric aggregates, some of which go on to support formation of a complete microtubule. Microtubule nucleation usually occurs from a specific site within a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of thalamus size
description: Any process that modulates the size of the thalamus. The thalamus is a part of the diencephalon that is composed of the dorsal thalamus and the ventral thalamus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of cell cycle process
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of a cellular process that is involved in the progression of biochemical and morphological phases and events that occur in a cell during successive cell replication or nuclear replication events.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of ribosome biogenesis
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of ribosome biogenesis. Ribosome biogenesis is the cellular process that results in the biosynthesis of constituent macromolecules, assembly, and arrangement of constituent parts of ribosome subunits.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of ribosome biogenesis
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of ribosome biogenesis. Ribosome biogenesis is the cellular process that results in the biosynthesis of constituent macromolecules, assembly, and arrangement of constituent parts of ribosome subunits.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: relaxation of muscle
description: A process in which the extent of muscle contraction is reduced. Muscle relaxation can involve a number of processes including the removal of calcium from the cytoplasm to the sarcoplasmic reticulum lumen through the action of Ca2+ ATPases. In some muscles, calcium-independent pathways also play a role in muscle relaxation by decreasing the phosphorylation state of myosin light chain.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: relaxation of skeletal muscle
description: A process in which the extent of skeletal muscle tissue contraction is reduced. Muscle relaxation involves the removal of calcium from the cytoplasm to the sarcoplasmic reticulum lumen through the action of Ca2+ ATPases.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: foam cell differentiation
description: The process in which a relatively unspecialized cell acquires the specialized features of a foam cell. A foam cell is a type of cell containing lipids in small vacuoles and typically seen in atherosclerotic lesions, as well as other conditions.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of inclusion body assembly
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of inclusion body assembly. Inclusion body assembly is the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form an inclusion body.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of inclusion body assembly
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of inclusion body assembly. Inclusion body assembly is the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form an inclusion body.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of protein deubiquitination
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of protein deubiquitination. Protein deubiquitination is the removal of one or more ubiquitin groups from a protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of protein deubiquitination
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of protein deubiquitination. Protein deubiquitination is the removal of one or more ubiquitin groups from a protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of canonical Wnt signaling pathway
synonyms: negative regulation of Wnt receptor signaling pathway through beta-catenin|negative regulation of canonical Wnt receptor signaling pathway|negative regulation of canonical Wnt receptor signalling pathway|negative regulation of canonical Wnt-activated signaling pathway|negative regulation of catenin import into nucleus|negative regulation of catenin protein nuclear translocation
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of the Wnt signaling pathway through beta-catenin, the series of molecular signals initiated by binding of a Wnt protein to a frizzled family receptor on the surface of the target cell, followed by propagation of the signal via beta-catenin, and ending with a change in transcription of target genes.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of extracellular matrix disassembly
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of extracellular matrix disassembly. Extracellular matrix disassembly is a process that results in the breakdown of the extracellular matrix.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of transmembrane receptor protein serine/threonine kinase signaling pathway
synonyms: regulation of transmembrane receptor protein serine/threonine kinase signalling pathway
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of the series of molecular signals generated as a consequence of a transmembrane receptor serine/threonine kinase binding to its physiological ligand.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: metanephric cap mesenchymal cell proliferation involved in metanephros development
description: The multiplication or reproduction of metanephric cap mesenchymal cells, resulting in the expansion of the cell population. A metanephric cap mesenchymal cell is a mesenchymal cell that has condensed with other mesenchymal cells surrounding the ureteric bud tip.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of metanephric cap mesenchymal cell proliferation
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate, or extent of metanephric cap mesenchymal cell proliferation. Metanephric cap mesenchymal cell proliferation is the multiplication or reproduction of metanephric cap mesenchymal cells, resulting in the expansion of the cell population. A metanephric cap mesenchymal cell is a mesenchymal cell that has condensed with other mesenchymal cells surrounding the ureteric bud tip.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of transmembrane receptor protein serine/threonine kinase signaling pathway
synonyms: positive regulation of transmembrane receptor protein serine/threonine kinase signalling pathway
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of the series of molecular signals generated as a consequence of a transmembrane receptor serine/threonine kinase binding to its physiological ligand.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of transmembrane receptor protein serine/threonine kinase signaling pathway
synonyms: negative regulation of transmembrane receptor protein serine/threonine kinase signalling pathway
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of the series of molecular signals generated as a consequence of a transmembrane receptor serine/threonine kinase binding to its physiological ligand.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cochlea development
description: The progression of the cochlea over time from its formation to the mature structure. The cochlea is the snail-shaped portion of the inner ear that is responsible for the detection of sound.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cochlea morphogenesis
description: The process in which the cochlea is generated and organized.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: pancreatic epsilon cell differentiation
description: The process in which relatively unspecialized cells acquire specialized structural and functional features of a pancreatic epsilon cell. A pancreatic epsilon cell is a cell in the pancreas that secretes ghrelin.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of high-density lipoprotein particle assembly
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of high-density lipoprotein particle assembly. High-density lipoprotein particle assembly is the aggregation and arrangement of proteins and lipids to form a high-density lipoprotein particle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of high-density lipoprotein particle assembly
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate, or extent of high-density lipoprotein particle assembly. High-density lipoprotein particle assembly is the aggregation and arrangement of proteins and lipids to form a high-density lipoprotein particle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: COPII-coated vesicle cargo loading
synonyms: COPII coat-cargo complex assembly|cargo loading into COPII vesicle|cargo loading into COPII-coated vesicle|cargo selection into COPII-coated vesicle
description: The formation of a macromolecular complex between the COPII coat proteins and proteins and/or lipoproteins that are going to be transported by the COPII vesicle to the Golgi.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of COPII vesicle uncoating
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of COPII vesicle uncoating, the process in which COPII vesicle coat proteins are disassembled, and released.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: COPII-coated vesicle budding
synonyms: COPII vesicle budding|ER exit|ER vesicle budding
description: The evagination of an endoplasmic reticulum membrane, resulting in formation of a COPII-coated vesicle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endosome to lysosome transport of low-density lipoprotein particle
synonyms: endosome to lysosome transport of LDL
description: The directed movement of low-density lipoprotein particle from endosomes to lysosomes.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: receptor-mediated endocytosis involved in cholesterol transport
synonyms: receptor-mediated endocytosis involved in intracellular cholesterol transport|receptor-mediated endocytosis of LDL|receptor-mediated endocytosis of low-density lipoprotein involved in cholesterol transport|receptor-mediated endocytosis of low-density lipoprotein particle involved in cholesterol transport
description: A receptor-mediated endocytosis process involved in intracellular cholesterol transport.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: vesicle-mediated cholesterol transport
description: The directed movement of cholesterol, cholest-5-en-3-beta-ol, or cholesterol-containing compounds, by membrane-bounded vesicles.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lysosome to ER cholesterol transport
synonyms: lysosome to endoplasmic reticulum cholesterol transport
description: The directed movement of cholesterol, cholest-5-en-3-beta-ol, or cholesterol-containing compounds, from the lysosome to the endoplasmic reticulum.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cholesterol ester hydrolysis involved in cholesterol transport
description: The cholesterol metabolic process in which cholesterol esters are hydrolyzed into free fatty acids and cholesterol in the lysosome that contributes to intracellular cholesterol transport.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein-containing complex assembly involved in synapse maturation
synonyms: protein complex assembly involved in synapse maturation
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a protein complex that contributes to synapse maturation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of synapse maturation
description: Any process that modulates the extent of synapse maturation, the process that organizes a synapse so that it attains its fully functional state.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of synapse maturation
description: Any process that increases the extent of synapse maturation, the process that organizes a synapse so that it attains its fully functional state.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mesenchyme migration
description: The process in which the population of cells that make up a mesenchyme undergo directed movement.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: epithelium migration
description: The process in which the population of cells that make up an epithelium undergo directed movement.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mesendoderm migration
description: The process in which the population of cells that make up a mesendoderm undergo directed movement. The mesendoderm is the epithelial tissue that gives rise to both mesoderm and endoderm.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cell migration involved in mesendoderm migration
description: The orderly movement of epithelial cells from one site to another that contributes to the migration of mesendodermal tissue.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: actin filament branching
description: The formation of daughter actin filament branches at an angle on the sides of preexisting mother filaments.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: epithelial cell-cell adhesion
description: The attachment of an epithelial cell to another epithelial cell via adhesion molecules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of mitochondrial fission
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of mitochondrial fission. Mitochondrial fission is the division of a mitochondrion within a cell to form two or more separate mitochondrial compartments.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of mitochondrial fission
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of mitochondrial fission. Mitochondrial fission is the division of a mitochondrion within a cell to form two or more separate mitochondrial compartments.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: membrane fission
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the separation of a single continuous membrane into two membranes.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial membrane fission
synonyms: membrane fission involved in mitochondrial fission|mitochondrial membrane scission
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the separation of a single continuous mitochondrial membrane into two membranes and contributes to mitochondrial fission.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: establishment of protein localization to membrane
synonyms: establishment of protein localisation in membrane|establishment of protein localization in membrane
description: The directed movement of a protein to a specific location in a membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of sphingolipid biosynthetic process
synonyms: negative regulation of sphingolipid biosynthesis involved in cellular sphingolipid homeostasis
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of sphingolipid biosynthesis. Sphingolipid biosynthesis is the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of sphingolipids, any of a class of lipids containing the long-chain amine diol sphingosine or a closely related base (a sphingoid).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intracellular sphingolipid homeostasis
description: A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of sphingolipids within a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endoplasmic reticulum membrane organization
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of an endoplasmic reticulum membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: Golgi to lysosome transport
description: The directed movement of substances from the Golgi to lysosomes.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: Golgi ribbon formation
description: The formation of a continuous ribbon of interconnected Golgi stacks of flat cisternae.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: establishment of epithelial cell polarity
description: The specification and formation of anisotropic intracellular organization of an epithelial cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: asymmetric Golgi ribbon formation
description: The asymmetric formation of a continuous ribbon of interconnected Golgi stacks of flat cisternae that contributes to the establishment of epithelial cell polarity.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: Golgi disassembly
description: A cellular process that results in the breakdown of a Golgi apparatus that contributes to Golgi inheritance.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: Golgi reassembly
description: The reformation of the Golgi following its breakdown and partitioning contributing to Golgi inheritance.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of spindle assembly
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of spindle assembly. Spindle assembly is the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form the spindle, the array of microtubules and associated molecules that serves to move duplicated chromosomes apart.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of Golgi inheritance
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of Golgi inheritance. Golgi inheritance is the partitioning of Golgi apparatus between daughter cells at cell division.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: organelle membrane fusion
description: The joining of two lipid bilayers to form a single organelle membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of establishment of planar polarity
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of the establishment of planar polarity, the coordinated organization of groups of cells in a tissue, such that they all orient to similar coordinates.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: microtubule cytoskeleton organization involved in establishment of planar polarity
synonyms: microtubule cytoskeleton organisation involved in establishment of planar polarity
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of cytoskeletal structures comprising microtubules and their associated proteins and contributes to the establishment of planar polarity.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of cholesterol metabolic process
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of cholesterol metabolism, the chemical reactions and pathways involving cholesterol, cholest-5-en-3 beta-ol, the principal sterol of vertebrates and the precursor of many steroids, including bile acids and steroid hormones.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of kidney development
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of kidney development. Kidney development is the process whose specific outcome is the progression of the kidney over time, from its formation to the mature structure. The kidney is an organ that filters the blood and excretes the end products of body metabolism in the form of urine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of kidney development
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of kidney development. Kidney development is the process whose specific outcome is the progression of the kidney over time, from its formation to the mature structure. The kidney is an organ that filters the blood and excretes the end products of body metabolism in the form of urine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of pancreatic juice secretion
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of pancreatic juice secretion, the regulated release of pancreatic juice by the exocrine pancreas into the upper part of the intestine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of branching involved in ureteric bud morphogenesis
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of branching involved in ureteric bud morphogenesis, the process in which the branching structure of the ureteric bud is generated and organized. The ureteric bud is an epithelial tube that grows out from the metanephric duct. The bud elongates and branches to give rise to the ureter and kidney collecting tubules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of branching involved in ureteric bud morphogenesis
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of branching involved in ureteric bud morphogenesis, the process in which the branching structure of the ureteric bud is generated and organized. The ureteric bud is an epithelial tube that grows out from the metanephric duct. The bud elongates and branches to give rise to the ureter and kidney collecting tubules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of branching involved in ureteric bud morphogenesis
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of branching involved in ureteric bud morphogenesis, the process in which the branching structure of the ureteric bud is generated and organized. The ureteric bud is an epithelial tube that grows out from the metanephric duct. The bud elongates and branches to give rise to the ureter and kidney collecting tubules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of glomerulus development
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of glomerulus development, the progression of the glomerulus over time from its initial formation until its mature state. The glomerulus is a capillary tuft surrounded by Bowman's capsule in nephrons of the vertebrate kidney.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of glomerulus development
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of glomerulus development, the progression of the glomerulus over time from its initial formation until its mature state. The glomerulus is a capillary tuft surrounded by Bowman's capsule in nephrons of the vertebrate kidney.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of release of cytochrome c from mitochondria
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of release of cytochrome c from mitochondria, the process in which cytochrome c is enabled to move from the mitochondrial intermembrane space into the cytosol, which is an early step in apoptosis and leads to caspase activation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of release of cytochrome c from mitochondria
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of release of cytochrome c from mitochondria, the process in which cytochrome c is enabled to move from the mitochondrial intermembrane space into the cytosol, which is an early step in apoptosis and leads to caspase activation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to nuclear pore
description: A process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained in, a nuclear pore.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of cholesterol metabolic process
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of cholesterol metabolism, the chemical reactions and pathways involving cholesterol, cholest-5-en-3 beta-ol, the principal sterol of vertebrates and the precursor of many steroids, including bile acids and steroid hormones.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of cholesterol metabolic process
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of cholesterol metabolism, the chemical reactions and pathways involving cholesterol, cholest-5-en-3 beta-ol, the principal sterol of vertebrates and the precursor of many steroids, including bile acids and steroid hormones.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of triglyceride metabolic process
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways involving triglyceride, any triester of glycerol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of triglyceride metabolic process
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways involving triglyceride, any triester of glycerol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of triglyceride metabolic process
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways involving triglyceride, any triester of glycerol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of establishment of blood-brain barrier
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of the establishment of the blood-brain barrier, a selectively permeable structural and functional barrier that exists between the capillaries and the brain.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of lipid kinase activity
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of lipid kinase activity, the catalysis of the transfer of a phosphate group, usually from ATP, to a simple or complex lipid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: centrosome-templated microtubule nucleation
description: The 'de novo' formation of a microtubule, in which tubulin heterodimers form metastable oligomeric aggregates from the centrosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of kinetochore assembly
synonyms: regulation of NMS complex assembly|regulation of chromosome-kinetochore attachment
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of kinetochore assembly, the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form the kinetochore, a multisubunit complex that is located at the centromeric region of DNA and provides an attachment point for the spindle microtubules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of metaphase plate congression
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of metaphase plate congression, the alignment of chromosomes at the metaphase plate, a plane halfway between the poles of the spindle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of arachidonate secretion
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of arachidonic acid secretion, the controlled release of arachidonic acid from a cell or a tissue.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of arachidonate secretion
synonyms: positive regulation of arachidonic acid secretion
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of arachidonic acid secretion, the controlled release of arachidonic acid from a cell or a tissue.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of cell migration involved in somitogenic axis elongation
synonyms: regulation of cell motility involved in somitogenic axis elongation
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of the controlled self-propelled movement of a cell that contributes to somitogenic axis elongation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of muscle system process
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of a muscle system process, a multicellular organismal process carried out by any of the organs or tissues in a muscle system.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of mitochondrial fission
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of mitochondrial fission. Mitochondrial fission is the division of a mitochondrion within a cell to form two or more separate mitochondrial compartments.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of retinal ganglion cell axon guidance
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of retinal ganglion cell axon guidance, the process in which the migration of an axon growth cone of a retinal ganglion cell (RGC) is directed to its target in the brain in response to a combination of attractive and repulsive cues.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of retinal ganglion cell axon guidance
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate, or extent of retinal ganglion cell axon guidance, the process in which the migration of an axon growth cone of a retinal ganglion cell (RGC) is directed to its target in the brain in response to a combination of attractive and repulsive cues.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of inclusion body assembly
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of inclusion body assembly. Inclusion body assembly is the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form an inclusion body.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of transcription-coupled nucleotide-excision repair
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of the nucleotide-excision repair process that carries out preferential repair of DNA lesions on the actively transcribed strand of the DNA duplex. In addition, the transcription-coupled nucleotide-excision repair pathway is required for the recognition and repair of a small subset of lesions that are not recognized by the global genome nucleotide excision repair pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of mitotic cell cycle spindle assembly checkpoint
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of the mitotic cell cycle spindle assembly checkpoint, a cell cycle checkpoint that delays the metaphase/anaphase transition of a mitotic nuclear division until the spindle is correctly assembled and chromosomes are attached to the spindle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of mitotic cell cycle spindle assembly checkpoint
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of the mitotic cell cycle spindle assembly checkpoint, a cell cycle checkpoint that delays the metaphase/anaphase transition of a mitotic nuclear division until the spindle is correctly assembled and chromosomes are attached to the spindle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of fibroblast growth factor production
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of the appearance of a fibroblast growth factor due to biosynthesis or secretion following a cellular stimulus, resulting in an increase in its intracellular or extracellular levels.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of fibroblast growth factor production
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of the appearance of a fibroblast growth factor due to biosynthesis or secretion following a cellular stimulus, resulting in an increase in its intracellular or extracellular levels.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of somatostatin secretion
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, extent of the regulated release of somatostatin from secretory granules in the D cells of the pancreas.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of peptide hormone secretion
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of the regulated release of a peptide hormone from secretory granules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of peptide hormone secretion
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of the regulated release of a peptide hormone from secretory granules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of calcium ion import
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of the directed movement of calcium ions into a cell or organelle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of calcium ion import

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of calcium ion import
synonyms: negative regulation of transmembrane calcium influx
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of the directed movement of calcium ions into a cell or organelle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of cellular response to growth factor stimulus
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a growth factor stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of cellular response to growth factor stimulus
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a growth factor stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of osteoclast proliferation
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of the multiplication or reproduction of osteoclasts, resulting in the expansion of an osteoclast cell population.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of osteoclast proliferation
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of the multiplication or reproduction of osteoclasts, resulting in the expansion of an osteoclast cell population.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: nuclear matrix anchoring at nuclear membrane
description: The process in which the nuclear matrix, the dense fibrillar network lying on the inner side of the nuclear membrane, is directly or indirectly linked to the nuclear membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of mitochondrial DNA replication
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of the process in which new strands of DNA are synthesized in the mitochondrion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of mitochondrial DNA replication
synonyms: positive regulation of mitochondrial DNA synthesis
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of the process in which new strands of DNA are synthesized in the mitochondrion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of mitochondrial DNA replication
synonyms: negative regulation of mitochondrial DNA synthesis
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of the process in which new strands of DNA are synthesized in the mitochondrion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of neural crest formation
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of neural crest formation. Neural crest formation is the formation of the specialized region of ectoderm between the neural ectoderm (neural plate) and non-neural ectoderm. The neural crest gives rise to the neural crest cells that migrate away from this region as neural tube formation proceeds.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of wound healing
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of the series of events that restore integrity to a damaged tissue, following an injury.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: nucleic acid metabolic process
description: Any cellular metabolic process involving nucleic acids.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: meiotic spindle assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form the spindle that contributes to the process of meiosis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitotic spindle assembly
description: Mitotic bipolar spindle assembly begins with spindle microtubule nucleation from the separated spindle pole body, includes spindle elongation during prometaphase, and is complete when all kinetochores are stably attached the spindle, and the spindle assembly checkpoint is satisfied.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of DNA methylation-dependent heterochromatin formation
synonyms: negative regulation of DNA methylation-dependent heterochromatin assembly|negative regulation of methylation-dependent chromatin silencing
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of DNA methylation-dependent heterochromatin formation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of protein deacetylation
synonyms: positive regulation of protein amino acid deacetylation
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of protein deacetylation, the removal of an acetyl group from a protein amino acid. An acetyl group is CH3CO-, derived from acetic [ethanoic] acid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of protein targeting to membrane
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the process of directing proteins towards a membrane, usually using signals contained within the protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of protein targeting to membrane
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of the process of directing proteins towards a membrane, usually using signals contained within the protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of protein targeting to membrane
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of the process of directing proteins towards a membrane, usually using signals contained within the protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of intracellular protein transport
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the directed movement of proteins within cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of chylomicron remodeling
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of chylomicron remodeling. Chylomicron remodeling is the acquisition, loss or modification of a protein or lipid within a chylomicron, including the hydrolysis of triglyceride by lipoprotein lipase and the subsequent loss of free fatty acid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of chylomicron remodeling
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of chylomicron remodeling. Chylomicron remodeling is the acquisition, loss or modification of a protein or lipid within a chylomicron, including the hydrolysis of triglyceride by lipoprotein lipase and the subsequent loss of free fatty acid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of chylomicron remnant clearance
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency or extent of chylomicron remnant clearance. Chylomicron clearance is the process in which a chylomicron remnant is removed from the blood via receptor-mediated endocytosis into liver cells and its constituent parts degraded.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of superoxide metabolic process
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of superoxide metabolism, the chemical reactions and pathways involving superoxide, the superoxide anion O2- (superoxide free radical), or any compound containing this species.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of oxidative phosphorylation
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the phosphorylation of ADP to ATP that accompanies the oxidation of a metabolite through the operation of the respiratory chain. Oxidation of compounds establishes a proton gradient across the membrane, providing the energy for ATP synthesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of locomotion involved in locomotory behavior
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of the self-propelled movement of a cell or organism from one location to another in a behavioral context; the aspect of locomotory behavior having to do with movement.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of locomotion involved in locomotory behavior
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate, or extent of the self-propelled movement of a cell or organism from one location to another in a behavioral context; the aspect of locomotory behavior having to do with movement.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of locomotion involved in locomotory behavior
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate, or extent of the self-propelled movement of a cell or organism from one location to another in a behavioral context; the aspect of locomotory behavior having to do with movement.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of DNA-templated DNA replication
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of DNA-templated DNA replication, the process in which new strands of DNA are synthesized.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of platelet aggregation
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency or extent of platelet aggregation. Platelet aggregation is the adhesion of one platelet to one or more other platelets via adhesion molecules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of platelet aggregation
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of platelet aggregation. Platelet aggregation is the adhesion of one platelet to one or more other platelets via adhesion molecules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of brown fat cell differentiation
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of brown fat cell differentiation. Brown fat cell differentiation is the process in which a relatively unspecialized cell acquires specialized features of a brown adipocyte, an animal connective tissue cell involved in adaptive thermogenesis. Brown adipocytes contain multiple small droplets of triglycerides and a high number of mitochondria.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of brown fat cell differentiation
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of brown fat cell differentiation. Brown fat cell differentiation is the process in which a relatively unspecialized cell acquires specialized features of a brown adipocyte, an animal connective tissue cell involved in adaptive thermogenesis. Brown adipocytes contain multiple small droplets of triglycerides and a high number of mitochondria.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of secretion of lysosomal enzymes
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of secretion of lysosomal enzymes, the controlled release of lysosomal enzymes by a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: organofluorine metabolic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways involving organofluorine compounds, as carried out by individual cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of organofluorine metabolic process
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways involving organofluorine compounds, as carried out by individual cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of platelet-derived growth factor production
description: Any process that increases the rate, frequency, or extent of the appearance of any platelet-derived growth factor due to biosynthesis or secretion following a cellular stimulus, resulting in an increase in its intracellular or extracellular levels.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of proteasome assembly
description: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a mature, active proteasome complex.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of mRNA modification
description: Any process that decreases the rate, frequency, or extent of the covalent alteration of one or more nucleotides within an mRNA molecule to produce an mRNA molecule with a sequence that differs from that coded genetically.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of cholesterol efflux
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of cholesterol efflux. Cholesterol efflux is the directed movement of cholesterol, cholest-5-en-3-beta-ol, out of a cell or organelle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: phagosome maturation
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the arrangement of constituent parts of a phagosome within a cell. Phagosome maturation begins with endocytosis and formation of the early phagosome and ends with the formation of the hybrid organelle, the phagolysosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: phagosome acidification
description: Any process that reduces the pH of the phagosome, corresponding to an increase in hydrogen ion concentration.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: phagosome-lysosome fusion
description: The creation of a phagolysosome from a phagosome and a lysosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of excitatory postsynaptic potential
synonyms: negative regulation of EPSP|negative regulation of excitatory post-synaptic membrane potential|reduction of excitatory postsynaptic membrane potential
description: Any process that prevents the establishment or decreases the extent of the excitatory postsynaptic potential (EPSP) which is a temporary increase in postsynaptic potential due to the flow of positively charged ions into the postsynaptic cell. The flow of ions that causes an EPSP is an excitatory postsynaptic current (EPSC) and makes it easier for the neuron to fire an action potential.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular senescence
description: A cell aging process stimulated in response to cellular stress, whereby normal cells lose the ability to divide through irreversible cell cycle arrest.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: replicative senescence
description: The process by which normal somatic cells reach an irreversible stage of cell cycle arrest following multiple rounds of replication; this end stage is associated with marked changes in gene expression and function. This is a natural barrier to unlimited proliferation of somatic cells, and is believed to be contolled by telomere shortening.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: stress-induced premature senescence
description: A cellular senescence process associated with the dismantling of a cell as a response to environmental factors such as hydrogen peroxide or X-rays.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: oncogene-induced cell senescence
description: A cellular senescence process associated with the dismantling of a cell as a response to oncogenic stress, such as the activation of the Ras oncogenic family.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: oxidative stress-induced premature senescence
description: A cellular senescence process associated with the dismantling of a cell as a response to oxidative stress, e.g. high levels of reactive oxygen species, such as superoxide anions, hydrogen peroxide, and hydroxyl radicals.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: organophosphate biosynthetic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the biosynthesis of deoxyribose phosphate, the phosphorylated sugar 2-deoxy-erythro-pentose.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to nuclear envelope
description: A process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained at, a location within a nuclear envelope.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intracellular aspartate homeostasis
description: A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of aspartate within a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intracellular glutamate homeostasis
description: A homeostatic process involved in the maintenance of a steady state level of glutamate within a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: dibasic protein processing
description: Any protein processing achieved by the cleavage of a peptide bond after two basic amino acids within a protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: pyrimidine nucleotide-sugar transmembrane transport
synonyms: pyrimidine nucleotide-sugar membrane transport|pyrimidine nucleotide-sugar transport
description: The process in which a pyrimidine nucleotide-sugar is transported across a membrane. Pyrimidine nucleotide-sugars are pyrimidine nucleotides in glycosidic linkage with a monosaccharide or monosaccharide derivative.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: catecholamine uptake
description: The directed movement of catecholamine into a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: dopamine uptake
description: The directed movement of dopamine into a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endocardial cushion to mesenchymal transition
description: A transition where an endocardial cushion cell loses apical/basolateral polarity, severs intercellular adhesive junctions, degrades basement membrane components and becomes a migratory mesenchymal cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: podocyte cell migration
description: The orderly movement of a podocyte from one site to another, often during the development of a multicellular organism or multicellular structure. A podocyte is a specialized kidney epithelial cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: establishment of endothelial intestinal barrier
description: The establishment of a barrier between endothelial cell layers of the intestine to exert specific and selective control over the passage of water and solutes, thus allowing formation and maintenance of compartments that differ in fluid and solute composition.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of membrane permeability
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the passage or uptake of molecules by a membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: inflammatory response to wounding
description: The immediate defensive reaction by vertebrate tissue to injury caused by chemical or physical agents.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: sensory organ morphogenesis
description: Morphogenesis of a sensory organ. A sensory organ is defined as a tissue or set of tissues that work together to receive and transmit signals from external or internal stimuli. Morphogenesis is the process in which anatomical structures are generated and organized. Organs are commonly observed as visibly distinct structures, but may also exist as loosely associated clusters of cells that work together to perform a specific function or functions.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial mRNA processing
description: Steps involved in processing precursor RNAs arising from transcription of operons in the mitochondrial genome into mature mRNAs.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial mRNA 3'-end processing
description: Any process involved in forming the mature 3' end of an mRNA molecule that derives from the mitochondrial genome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: siRNA-mediated gene silencing by mRNA destabilization
synonyms: gene silencing by mRNA cleavage|mRNA cleavage involved in gene silencing by siRNA|mRNA destabilization-mediated gene silencing by siRNA
description: An siRNA-mediated post-transcriptional gene silencing pathway in which small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) direct the cleavage of target mRNAs. Once incorporated into a RNA-induced silencing complex (RISC), an siRNA will typically direct cleavage by base pairing with perfect or near-perfect complementarity to the target mRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: activation of GTPase activity
synonyms: ARF GTPase activation|Cdc42 GTPase activation|Rab GTPase activation|Rac GTPase activation|Ral GTPase activation|Ran GTPase activation|Rap GTPase activation|Ras GTPase activation|Rho GTPase activation|activation of ARF GTPase activity|activation of Cdc42 GTPase activity|activation of Rab GTPase activity|activation of Rac GTPase activity|activation of Ral GTPase activity|activation of Ran GTPase activity|activation of Rap GTPase activity|activation of Ras GTPase activity|activation of Rho GTPase activity
description: Any process that initiates the activity of an inactive GTPase through the replacement of GDP by GTP.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial tRNA processing
description: The process in which a pre-tRNA molecule is converted to a mature tRNA, ready for addition of an aminoacyl group, in the mitochondrion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: response to oxygen-glucose deprivation
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of the deprivation of oxygen and glucose.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular response to oxygen-glucose deprivation
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of the deprivation of oxygen and glucose.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: t-circle formation
description: A telomere maintenance process that results in the formation of a telomeric circle, or t-circle. A t-circle is an extrachromosomal duplex or single-stranded circular DNA molecule composed of t-arrays. T-circles are involved in the control of telomere length via alternative-lengthening of telomeres (ALT) pathway and telomere rapid deletion (TRD).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: telomeric loop disassembly
description: The telomere maintenance process in which telomeric loops are disassembled to permit efficient telomere replication.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cerebrospinal fluid circulation
description: The neurological system process driven by motile cilia on ependymal cells of the brain by which cerebrospinal fluid circulates from the sites of secretion to the sites of absorption. In ventricular cavities, the flow is unidirectional and rostrocaudal, in subarachnoid spaces, the flow is multi-directional.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: scaRNA localization to Cajal body
description: A process in which a small Cajal body-specific RNA is transported to, or maintained in, a Cajal body.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: telomerase RNA stabilization
description: Prevention of degradation of telomerase RNA (TERC) molecules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: telomerase RNA localization to Cajal body
description: A process in which telomerase RNA (TERC) is transported to, or maintained in, a Cajal body.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endothelial cell-matrix adhesion
description: The binding of an endothelial cell to the extracellular matrix via adhesion molecules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intermicrovillar adhesion
description: The cell-cell adhesion process by which adjacent microvilli attach to each other through Ca(2+)-dependent adhesion links made of protocadherin-24 and mucin-like protocadherin.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: calcium ion transmembrane transport via low voltage-gated calcium channel
description: A process in which a calcium ion is transported from one side of a membrane to the other by means of a low voltage-gated calcium channel.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: adaptive immune memory response
description: An immune response directed against a previously encountered antigen, being quicker and quantitatively better compared with the primary response.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: adaptive immune memory response involving T cells and B cells
description: An immune response mediated by reactivated memory T cells and B cells and directed against a previously encountered antigen, being quicker and quantitatively better compared with the primary response.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: primary adaptive immune response
description: An adaptive immune response against an antigen not previously encountered by immune system.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: primary adaptive immune response involving T cells and B cells
description: An adaptive immune response mediated by naive T or B cells against an antigen not previously encountered by immune system.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: telomere maintenance via telomere trimming
description: A process that contributes to the maintenance of proper telomeric length and structure via the activation of telomere shortening pathways that compensate telomerase-dependent excessive telomere elongation. Telomere attrition is mediated by a mechanism which involves the generation of single-stranded C-rich telomeric DNA, and the formation and removal of double-stranded telomeric circular DNA (T-circles). Telomere trimming is an independent pathway to recombination-mediated telomere elongation and the well-documented gradual telomere attrition that accompanies cellular replication.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: acetylcholine receptor signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals generated as a consequence of an acetylcholine receptor binding to one of its physiological ligands.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of plasma lipoprotein particle levels
description: Any process involved in the maintenance of internal levels of plasma lipoprotein particles within an organism.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: energy homeostasis
synonyms: negative regulation of energy homeostasis|positive regulation of energy homeostasis|regulation of energy homeostasis
description: Any process involved in the balance between food intake (energy input) and energy expenditure.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular response to granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor stimulus
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: renal protein absorption
description: A renal system process in which proteins are taken up from the collecting ducts, glomerulus and proximal and distal loops of the nephron. In non-mammalian species, absorption may occur in related structures (e.g. protein absorption is observed in nephrocytes in Drosophila, see PMID:23264686).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: renal albumin absorption
description: A renal system process in which albumin is taken up from the collecting ducts, glomerulus and proximal and distal loops of the nephron.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lymphocyte migration into lymphoid organs
description: The movement of a lymphocyte within the lymphatic system into lymphoid organs such as lymph nodes, spleen or Peyer's patches, and its subsequent positioning within defined functional compartments such as sites of cell activation by antigen.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lymphocyte migration into lymph node
description: The movement of a lymphocyte within the lymphatic system into a lymph node, and its subsequent positioning within defined functional compartments such as sites of cell activation by antigen.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: dendritic cell dendrite assembly
description: Formation of dendrites, branched cellular projections (or cytoplasmic extension) that are extended from the surface of a dendritic immune cell, and which enable the cell to sample luminal pathogens and increase the surface area for antigen presentation to T cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: dendritic cell differentiation
description: The process in which a precursor cell type acquires the specialized features of a dendritic cell. A dendritic cell is a leukocyte of dendritic lineage specialized in the uptake, processing, and transport of antigens to lymph nodes for the purpose of stimulating an immune response via T cell activation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mature conventional dendritic cell differentiation
description: The process in which antigen-activated dendritic cells acquire the specialized features of a mature conventional dendritic cell. Mature conventional dendritic cells upregulate the surface expression of MHC molecules, chemokine receptors and adhesion molecules, and increase the number of dendrites (cytoplasmic protrusions) in preparation for migration to lymphoid organs where they present antigen to T cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of membrane lipid distribution
description: Any process that modulates the proportions or spatial arrangement of lipids in a cellular membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: heme export
description: The directed movement of heme out of a cell or organelle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein linear polyubiquitination
description: A protein ubiquitination process in which a linear polymer of ubiquitin, formed by the amino-terminal methionine (M1) of one ubiquitin molecule and by the carboxy-terminal glycine (G76) of the next, is added to a protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: phosphatidylserine exposure on blood platelet
description: A phospholipid scrambling process that results in the appearance of phosphatidylserine on the surface of activated blood platelets, and triggers the clotting system.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: motor neuron apoptotic process
description: Any apoptotic process in a motor neuron, an efferent neuron that passes from the central nervous system or a ganglion toward or to a muscle and conducts an impulse that causes movement.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: type B pancreatic cell apoptotic process
synonyms: pancreatic B cell apoptosis|pancreatic beta cell apoptosis|type B pancreatic cell apoptosis
description: Any apoptotic process in a type B pancreatic cell, a cell located towards center of the islets of Langerhans that secretes insulin.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: establishment of protein localization to endoplasmic reticulum membrane
synonyms: establishment of protein localisation in endoplasmic reticulum membrane|establishment of protein localization in endoplasmic reticulum membrane
description: The directed movement of a protein to a specific location in the endoplasmic reticulum membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: L-glutamate biosynthetic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of L-glutamate, the L enantiomer anion of 2-aminopentanedioic acid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: agmatine biosynthetic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of agmatine ((4-aminobutyl)guanidine, NH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH2-NH-C(-NH2)(=NH)). Agmatine is the decarboxylation product of the amino acid arginine and is an intermediate in polyamine biosynthesis. It is synthesized in the brain, stored in synaptic vesicles, accumulated by uptake, released by membrane depolarization, and inactivated by agmatinase.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: dendritic spine organization
