name: clathrin coat assembly involved in endocytosis
description: The process that results in the assembly of clathrin triskelia into a clathrin cage during endocytosis. Clathrin is recruited to the plasma membrane via interaction with scaffolding proteins that bridge between clathtin and cell surface receptors. Clathrin coat formation is concomittant with coated pit formation leading to endocytic vesicle formation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: vesicle scission
description: The membrane scission process that is the final step in the formation of a vesicle, leading to separation from its parent membrane. Vesicle scission involves the constriction of a neck-forming protein complex, consisting e.g. of dynamin, around the budded membrane, leading to vesicle closure during its separation from the parent membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: presynapse assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a presynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: postsynapse assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a postsynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of postsynaptic membrane neurotransmitter receptor levels
description: Any process that regulates the the local concentration of neurotransmitter receptor at the postsynaptic membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrion to lysosome vesicle-mediated transport
description: Vesicle-mediated transport of cargo from the mitochondrion to the lysosome, mediated by a mitochondrion-derived vesicle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: postsynaptic specialization organization
synonyms: post synaptic specialization organization|post-synaptic specialization organization|postsynaptic specialization organisation
description: A process that results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a postsynaptic specialization, a structure that lies adjacent to the cytoplasmic face of the postsynaptic membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: axonal transport of messenger ribonucleoprotein complex
synonyms: axonal transport of mRNA RNP complex
description: The directed movement of a messenger ribonucleoprotein complex along microtubules in axons.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: calcium export from the mitochondrion
synonyms: calcium ion transmembrane export from mitochondrion|mitochondrial calcium ion export|mitochondrial calcium release
description: A process in which a calcium ion (Ca2+) is transported out of the mitochondrial matrix, and into the cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: microtubule-based transport
description: A microtubule-based process that results in the transport of organelles, other microtubules, or other cellular components. Examples include motor-driven movement along microtubules and movement driven by polymerization or depolymerization of microtubules.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: tRNA 5'-end processing
description: The process in which the 5' end of a pre-tRNA molecule is converted to that of a mature tRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: somato-dendritic dopamine secretion
synonyms: STD DA release|STD dopamine release|somatodendritic dopamine release
description: The regulated release of dopamine from the somatodendritic compartment (cell body or dendrites) of a neuron.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: presynaptic actin cytoskeleton organization
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of cytoskeletal structures comprising actin filaments and their associated proteins in the presynaptic actin cytoskeleton.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor internalization
synonyms: regulation of postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor endocytosis
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of endocytosis of neurotransmitter receptor at the postsynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of postsynaptic specialization assembly
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of postsynaptic specialization assembly, the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a postsynaptic specialization.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of postsynaptic density assembly
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of postsynaptic density assembly, the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a postsynaptic density.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of neurotransmitter receptor transport, endosome to postsynaptic membrane
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the directed movement of neurotransmitter receptor from the postsynaptic endosome to the postsynaptic membrane in transport vesicles.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of recycling endosome localization within postsynapse
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of transport or maintenance of location of a postsynaptic recycling endosome within the postsynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of modification of postsynaptic structure
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of modification of postsynaptic structure.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of presynaptic dense core granule exocytosis
synonyms: regulation of presynaptic dense core vesicle exocytosis
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of presynaptic dense core granule exocytosis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: synaptic signaling by nitric oxide
description: Cell-cell signaling to or from a synapse, mediated by nitric oxide.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: postsynaptic modulation of chemical synaptic transmission
description: Any process, acting in the postsynapse that results in modulation of chemical synaptic transmission.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: presynaptic modulation of chemical synaptic transmission
description: Any process, acting in the presynapse that results in modulation of chemical synaptic transmission.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: presynapse organization
synonyms: presynapse development|presynapse morphogenesis|presynapse organisation|presynapse organization and biogenesis
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a presynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: postsynapse organization
synonyms: postsynapse development|postsynapse morphogenesis|postsynapse organisation|postsynapse organization and biogenesis
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a postsynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of presynapse organization
synonyms: regulation of presynapse organisation|regulation of presynapse organization and biogenesis|regulation of presynapse structure
description: Any process that modulates the physical form of a presynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of postsynapse organization
synonyms: regulation of postsynapse organisation|regulation of postsynapse organization and biogenesis|regulation of postsynapse structure
description: Any process that modulates the physical form of a postsynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of retrograde trans-synaptic signaling by endocanabinoid
synonyms: regulation of endocannabinoid-mediated retrograde trans-synaptic signaling
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of retrograde trans-synaptic signaling by an endocannabinoid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of synaptic membrane adhesion
synonyms: regulation of synapse adhesion between pre- and post-synapse
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of adhesion between pre- and post-synaptic membranes.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: zinc ion import into synaptic vesicle
synonyms: Zn2+ import into synaptic vesicle|zinc import into synaptic vesicle
description: The directed movement of Zn2+ ions from the cytoplasm into the lumen of a cytoplasmic vesicle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: trans-synaptic signaling by BDNF, modulating synaptic transmission
description: Cell-cell signaling between presynapse and postsynapse, via the vesicular release and reception of brain derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF), that modulates the synaptic transmission properties of the synapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: postsynaptic intermediate filament cytoskeleton organization
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of cytoskeletal structures comprised of intermediate filament and their associated proteins in the postsynaptic cytoskeleton.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: presynaptic cytoskeleton organization
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of cytoskeletal structures and their associated proteins in the presynaptic cytoskeleton.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: postsynaptic cytoskeleton organization
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of cytoskeletal structures comprising cytoskeletal filaments and their associated proteins in the postsynaptic cytoskeleton.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: vesicle fusion to plasma membrane
description: Fusion of the membrane of a vesicle with the plasma membrane, thereby releasing its contents into the extracellular space.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: calcium-dependent activation of synaptic vesicle fusion
description: The regulatory process by which increased cytosolic calcium levels lead to the the fusion of synaptic vesicles with the presynaptic active zone membrane by bringing primed synaptic vesicle membrane into contact with membrane presynaptic active zone membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: synaptic vesicle cycle
description: A biological process in which synaptic vesicles are loaded with neurotransmitters, move to the active zone, exocytose and are then recycled via endocytosis, ultimately leading to reloading with neurotransmitters.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of presynaptic membrane potential
description: Any process that modulates the potential difference across a presynaptic membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of presynaptic cytosolic calcium ion concentration
synonyms: regulation of presynaptic cytosolic calcium levels
description: Any process that regulates the concentration of calcium in the presynaptic cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: vesicle cytoskeletal trafficking
synonyms: cytoskeletal fiber-based vesicle localization|vesicle cytoskeletal transport
description: The directed movement of a vesicle along a cytoskeletal fiber such as a microtubule or and actin filament, mediated by motor proteins.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: dense core granule cytoskeletal transport
description: The directed movement of dense core granules along cytoskeletal fibers, such as microtubules or actin filaments.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: presynaptic dense core vesicle exocytosis
description: The secretion of molecules (e.g. neuropeptides and neuromodulators such as serotonin and dopamine) contained within a membrane-bounced dense in response to increased presynaptic cytosolic calcium levels.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: postsynapse to nucleus signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals that conveys information from the postsynapse to the nucleus via cytoskeletal transport of a protein from a postsynapse to the component to the nucleus where it affects biochemical processes that occur in the nucleus (e.g DNA transcription, mRNA splicing, or DNA/histone modifications).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: synaptic vesicle endosomal processing
description: The process in which synaptic vesicles fuse to the presynaptic endosome followed by sorting of synaptic vesicle components and budding of new synaptic vesicles.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of presynaptic cytosolic calcium concentration
description: Any process that increases the concentration of calcium ions in the presynaptic cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: synaptic signaling
description: Cell-cell signaling to, from or within a synapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: trans-synaptic signaling
description: Cell-cell signaling in either direction across the synaptic cleft.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: synaptic signaling via neuropeptide
description: Cell-cell signaling to or from a synapse, mediated by a peptide.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: trans-synaptic signaling by trans-synaptic complex
description: Cell-cell signaling between presynapse and postsynapse mediated by a trans-synaptic protein complex.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein catabolic process, modulating synaptic transmission
description: Any protein degradation process, occurring at a presynapse, that regulates synaptic transmission.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: trans-synaptic signaling, modulating synaptic transmission
description: Cell-cell signaling between presynapse and postsynapse, across the synaptic cleft, that modulates the synaptic transmission properties of the synapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: trans-synaptic signaling by endocannabinoid, modulating synaptic transmission
description: Cell-cell signaling between presynapse and postsynapse, via the release and reception of endocannabinoid ligands, that modulates the synaptic transmission properties of the synapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: trans-synaptic signaling by trans-synaptic complex, modulating synaptic transmission
description: Cell-cell signaling between presynapse and postsynapse, mediated by transynaptic protein complexes, that modulates the synaptic transmission properties of the synapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: maintenance of synapse structure
description: A process that preserves the structural organistation and orientation of a synaptic cellular component such as the synaptic cytoskeleton and molecular scaffolds.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: synaptic membrane adhesion
synonyms: synapse adhesion between pre- and post-synapse
description: The attachment of presynaptic membrane to postsynaptic membrane via adhesion molecules that are at least partially embedded in the plasma membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: maintenance of postsynaptic density structure
description: A process which maintains the organization and the arrangement of proteins in the presynaptic density.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: modification of synaptic structure
description: Any process that modifies the structure/morphology of a synapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: chemical synaptic transmission, postsynaptic
synonyms: postsynaptic process involved in chemical synaptic transmission
description: The part of synaptic transmission occurring in the post-synapse: a signal transduction pathway consisting of neurotransmitter receptor activation and its effects on postsynaptic membrane potential and the ionic composition of the postsynaptic cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of postsynaptic cytosolic calcium ion concentration
synonyms: regulation of postsynaptic cytosolic calcium levels
description: Any process that regulates the concentration of calcium in the postsynaptic cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of protein catabolic process at presynapse, modulating synaptic transmission
description: Any process that modulates synaptic transmission by regulating a catabolic process occurring at a presynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of protein catabolic process at postsynapse, modulating synaptic transmission
description: Any process that modulates synaptic transmission by regulating a catabolic process occurring at a postsynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of translation at presynapse, modulating synaptic transmission
description: Any process that modulates synaptic transmission by regulating translation occurring at the presynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of translation at postsynapse, modulating synaptic transmission
description: Any process that modulates synaptic transmission by regulating translation occurring at the postsynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of neurotransmitter receptor activity
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of neurotransmitter receptor activity. Modulation may be via an effect on ligand affinity, or effector function such as ion selectivity or pore opening/closing in ionotropic receptors.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: microtubule plus-end directed mitotic chromosome migration
description: The cell cycle process in which chromosomes that are laterally attached to one or more mitotic spindle microtubules migrate towards the spindle equator via plus-end-directed movement along the microtubules. This process is part of mitotic metaphase plate congression.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lateral attachment of mitotic spindle microtubules to kinetochore
description: The cellular process in which sister chromatids become laterally attached to spindle microtubules as part of mitotic metaphase plate congression. Attachment precedes migration along microtubules towards the spindle equator (metaphase plate).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: action potential initiation
description: The initiating cycle of an action potential. In vertebrate neurons this typically occurs at an axon hillock. Not all initiated axon potentials propagate.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to axon
description: A process in which a protein is transported to or maintained in a location within an axon.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: ventricular cardiac muscle cell membrane repolarization
description: The process in which ions are transported across the plasma membrane of a ventricular cardiac muscle cell such that the membrane potential changes in the repolarizing direction, toward the steady state potential. For example, the repolarization during an action potential is from a positive membrane potential towards a negative resting potential.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: neurotransmitter receptor transport
description: The directed movement of neurotransmitter receptors.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endosome to plasma membrane protein transport
description: The directed movement of proteins from the endosome to the plasma membrane in transport vesicles.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: neurotransmitter receptor transport, endosome to plasma membrane
description: The directed movement of neurotransmitter receptor from the endosome to the plasma membrane in transport vesicles.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: axo-dendritic protein transport
description: The directed movement of proteins along microtubules in neuron projections.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: anterograde axonal protein transport
description: The directed movement of proteins along microtubules from the cell body toward the cell periphery in nerve cell axons.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: retrograde axonal protein transport
description: The directed movement of proteins along microtubules from the cell periphery toward the cell body in nerve cell axons.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: neurotransmitter receptor localization to postsynaptic specialization membrane
synonyms: neurotransmitter receptor localisation in postsynaptic specialization membrane
description: A process in which a neurotransmitter is transported to, or maintained in, a location within the membrane adjacent to a postsynaptic specialization (e.g. postsynaptic density).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of skeletal muscle contraction by action potential
description: Any action potential process that regulates skeletal muscle contraction.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: vascular endothelial cell proliferation
description: The multiplication or reproduction of blood vessel endothelial cells, resulting in the expansion of a cell population.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intestinal hexose absorption
description: Uptake of hexoses, notably D-glucose, fructose, and galactose, into the blood by absorption from the small intestine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: tRNA (guanine-N7)-methylation
description: The process whereby a guanine in a tRNA is methylated at the N7 position of guanine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: RNA 5'-cap (guanine-N7)-methylation
description: The process whereby a guanine in 5-cap is methylated at the N7 position of guanine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of inflammatory response to wounding
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the inflammatory response to wounding.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of inflammatory response to wounding
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the inflammatory response to wounding.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of inflammatory response to wounding
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the inflammatory response to wounding.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: neuron projection organization
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a prolongation or process extending from a neuron, e.g. an axon, or a dendrite.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: neuron projection retraction
description: The organization process which results in the disassembly (either partial or complete) of constituent parts of a neuron projection. A neuron projection is a prolongation or process extending from a nerve cell, e.g. an axon or dendrite.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: neuron projection fasciculation
description: The collection of neuronal projections into a bundle of rods, known as a fascicle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of cellular response to osmotic stress
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the cellular response to osmotic stress.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of cobalamin catabolic process
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of cobalamin (vitamin B12) catabolic process.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway
synonyms: regulation of adenylate cyclase-activating G-protein coupled receptor signaling pathway
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of an adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway
synonyms: positive regulation of adenylate cyclase-activating G-protein coupled receptor signaling pathway
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of an adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway
synonyms: negative regulation of adenylate cyclase-activating G-protein coupled receptor signaling pathway
description: Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of an adenylate cyclase-activating G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: aminoacyl-tRNA metabolism involved in translational fidelity
description: Any process which detects an amino-acid acetylated tRNA is charged with the correct amino acid, or removes incorrect amino acids from a charged tRNA. This process can be performed by tRNA synthases, or by subsequent reactions after tRNA aminoacylation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of cell adhesion involved in sprouting angiogenesis
description: Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of cell adhesion involved in sprouting angiogenesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: glial cell projection elongation
description: The process of creating an elongation or projection from a glial cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: ER-dependent peroxisome localization
description: A process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained at, a location in a peroxisome via the endoplasmic reticulum.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cold-induced thermogenesis
description: The process by which heat is generated by increasing metabolism in response to cold ambient temperatures in order to maintain a stable core body temperature.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of cobalamin catabolic process
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of a cobalamin (vitamin B12) catabolic process.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of cardiac muscle cell contraction
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of cardiac muscle cell contraction.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of cardiac muscle cell contraction
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of cardiac muscle cell contraction.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: tRNA C3-cytosine methylation
description: The process whereby a cytosine in a tRNA is methylated at position 3 of the cytosine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: peptidyl-lysine glutarylation
description: The glutarylation of a lysine residue in a protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein depropionylation
description: The removal of a propionyl group from a residue in a peptide or protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of deadenylation-dependent decapping of nuclear-transcribed mRNA
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of deadenylation-dependent decapping of nuclear-transcribed mRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein-DNA covalent cross-linking repair
description: The removal of covalent cross-link between DNA and a protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: tRNA surveillance
description: The set of processes involved in identifying and degrading defective or aberrant tRNAs.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: purine ribonucleotide salvage
description: Any process which produces a purine ribonucleotide from derivatives of it, without de novo synthesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: dAMP salvage
description: Any process which produces a dAMP from derivatives of it, without de novo synthesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: Lewis x epitope biosynthetic process
synonyms: sLeX biosynthetic process|sialyl-Lewis X biosynthetic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of a Lewis x epitope, a trisaccharide (beta-D-galactosyl-(1,4)-[alpha-L-fucosyl-(1,3)]-N-acetyl-beta-D-glucosamine) expressed on several glycolipids, glycoproteins, and proteoglycans of the nervous system. The related Lewis x epitope is formed by alpha(1,3) fucosylation of the N-acetylglucosaminyl residue of a type 2 histo-blood group antigen precursor disaccharide.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of tRNA methylation
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways involving tRNA methylation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: basolateral protein secretion
description: The controlled release of proteins from a cell at the sides which interface adjacent cells and near the base.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of basement membrane organization
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the assembly, disassembly or arrangement of constituent parts of the basement membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to P-body
synonyms: protein localisation to P-body|protein localization to P body|protein localization to cytoplasmic mRNA processing body
description: Any process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained at, a P-body.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of cardiac muscle myoblast proliferation
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of cardiac muscle myoblast proliferation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: DNA strand resection involved in replication fork processing
description: The 5' to 3' exonucleolytic resection of DNA at the site of a stalled replication fork that contributes to replication fork processing.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of DNA strand resection involved in replication fork processing
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of DNA strand resection involved in replication fork processing.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of DNA strand resection involved in replication fork processing
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of DNA strand resection involved in replication fork processing.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of G2/MI transition of meiotic cell cycle
description: Any signaling pathway that decreases or inhibits the activity of a cell cycle cyclin-dependent protein kinase to modulate the switch from G2 phase to MI phase of the meiotic cell cycle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of G2/MI transition of meiotic cell cycle
description: Any signaling pathway that activates or increases the activity of a cell cycle cyclin-dependent protein kinase to modulate the switch from G2 phase to MI phase of the meiotic cell cycle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: metabolite repair
description: A cellular process that, through single- or multi-step enzymatic reactions, repairs useless or toxic endogenous compounds, formed as by-products of primary metabolism, by converting them into useful metabolites.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: toxic metabolite repair
description: A cellular process that, through single- or multi-step enzymatic reactions, repairs toxic endogenous compounds, formed as by-products of primary metabolism, by converting them into useful metabolites.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of actin filament organization
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of actin filament organization.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of blood vessel endothelial cell differentiation
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of blood vessel endothelial cell differentiation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of angiotensin-activated signaling pathway
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the angiotensin-activated signaling pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of angiotensin-activated signaling pathway
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the angiotensin-activated signaling pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of angiotensin-activated signaling pathway
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the angiotensin-activated signaling pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lncRNA catabolic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of lncRNAs, non-coding RNAs over 200 nucleotides in length.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of ferroptosis
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of ferroptosis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of ferroptosis
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of ferroptosis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: vesicle-mediated intercellular transport
description: A cellular transport process in which transported substances are moved in extracellular vesicles between cells; transported substances are enclosed in the vesicle lumen or located in the extracellular vesicle membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: hippocampal neuron apoptotic process
description: Any apoptotic process that occurs in a hippocampal neuron.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of hippocampal neuron apoptotic process
description: Any process that modulates the occurrence or rate of cell death by apoptotic process in hippocampal neurons.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of hippocampal neuron apoptotic process
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of cell death by apoptotic process in hippocampal neurons.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of hippocampal neuron apoptotic process
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of cell death by apoptotic process in hippocampal neurons.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular detoxification of aldehyde
description: Any process carried out at the cellular level that reduces or removes the toxicity of an aldehyde. These may include transport of aldehydes away from sensitive areas and to compartments or complexes whose purpose is sequestration of the toxic substance.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of calcium import into the mitochondrion
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of calcium import into the mitochondrion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of calcium import into the mitochondrion
description: Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of calcium ion import into the mitochondrion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mRNA alternative polyadenylation
description: The process of generating multiple mRNA molecules with variable 3'-end length formation from a given pre-mRNA by differential use of cleavage and polyadenylation signals (pA signals).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: Norrin signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by binding of the cysteine knot protein Norrin to a Frizzled 4 (Fzd4) family receptor on the surface of the target cell and ending with a change in cell state.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: RNA decapping
description: Cleavage of the 5'-cap of an RNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: NAD-cap decapping
description: Cleavage of the 5'-NAD-cap of an RNA. The NAD-cap is present at the 5'-end of some RNAs in both bacetria and eukaryotes. While it promotes RNA stability in bacteria, it promotes RNA decay in eukaryotes.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mRNA methylguanosine-cap decapping
description: Cleavage of the 5'-methylguanosine-cap of an mRNA. The methylguanosine-cap is present at the 5'-end of eukaryotic mRNAs. Decapping inactivates translation initiation and promotes 5'-to-3' decay of mRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intermembrane lipid transfer
description: The transport of lipids between membranes in which a lipid molecule is transported through an aqueous phase from the outer leaflet of a donor membrane to the outer leaflet of an acceptor membrane. This process does not require metabolic energy and can be either spontaneous or mediated by lipid transfer proteins (LTPs).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intermembrane phospholipid transfer
description: The transport of phospholipids between membranes in which a phospholipid molecule is transported through an aqueous phase from the outer leaflet of a donor membrane to the outer leaflet of an acceptor membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: intermembrane sphingolipid transfer
description: The transport of sphingolipids between membranes in which a sphingolipid molecule is transported through an aqueous phase from the outer leaflet of a donor membrane to the outer leaflet of an acceptor membrane. This process does not require metabolic energy and can be either spontaneous or mediated by lipid transfer proteins (LTPs).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: plasma membrane bounded cell projection assembly
description: Formation of a prolongation or process extending and that is bounded by plasma membrane, e.g. a cilium, lamellipodium, or axon.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of plasma membrane bounded cell projection assembly
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of plasma membrane bounded cell projection assembly.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of plasma membrane bounded cell projection organization
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of a process involved in the formation, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of plasma membrane bounded cell projections.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: plasma membrane bounded cell projection organization
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a plasma membrane bounded prolongation or process extending from a cell, e.g. a cilium or axon.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of macrophage proliferation
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of macrophage proliferation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: stereocilium maintenance
description: The organization process that preserves a stereocilium in a stable functional or structural state.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: snRNA (adenine-N6)-methylation
description: The posttranscriptional N6-methylation of an adenine residue in an snRNA molecule.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: large intestinal transit
synonyms: colon transit|colonic transit|large bowel transit|large intestine transit
description: Migration of ingested material along the length of the large intestine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of small intestinal transit
synonyms: positive regulation of small bowel transit|positive regulation of small intestine transit
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of any small intestinal transit process, the migration of ingested material along the length of the small intestine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of gastric emptying
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of any gastric emptying process, the process in which the liquid and liquid-suspended solid contents of the stomach exit through the pylorus into the duodenum.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of stomach fundus smooth muscle contraction
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of any stomach fundus smooth muscle contraction.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of pyloric antrum smooth muscle contraction
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of any pyloric antrum smooth muscle contraction.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cell adhesion involved in sprouting angiogenesis
synonyms: cell adhesion involved in blood vessel anastomosis|cell adhesion involved in vascular anastomosis
description: The attachment of a cell, either to another cell or to an underlying substrate such as the extracellular matrix, via cell adhesion molecules that contributes to the formation of a blood vessel network.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of peptidyl-lysine crotonylation
description: Any process that stops or reduces the rate of crotonylation of a lysine residue in a protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: glucagon processing
description: The formation of mature glucagon by proteolysis of the precursor proglucagon.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to basal ectoplasmic specialization
synonyms: protein localisation in basal ectoplasmic specialization|protein localisation to basal ectoplasmic specialization|protein localization in basal ectoplasmic specialization
description: A process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained in, a location within a basal ectoplasmic specialization.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of ERBB4 signaling pathway
description: Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of ERBB4 signaling pathway.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of collagen catabolic process
synonyms: activation of collagen catabolic process|positive regulation of collagen breakdown|positive regulation of collagen catabolism|positive regulation of collagen degradation|up regulation of collagen catabolic process|up-regulation of collagen catabolic process|upregulation of collagen catabolic process
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of collagen catabolism. Collagen catabolism is the proteolytic chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of collagen in the extracellular matrix.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of cold-induced thermogenesis
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of cold-induced thermogenesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of cold-induced thermogenesis
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of cold-induced thermogenesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of cold-induced thermogenesis
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the rate of cold-induced thermogenesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: detection of cold stimulus involved in thermoception
synonyms: sensory detection of cold stimulus during thermoception|sensory transduction of cold stimulus during thermoception|thermoception|sensory detection of cold stimulus|thermoception|sensory transduction of cold stimulus
description: The series of events in which a cold stimulus is received and converted into a molecular signal as part of thermoception.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: steroid hormone biosynthetic process
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of any steroid hormone, naturally occurring substances secreted by specialized cells that affects the metabolism or behavior of other cells possessing functional receptors for the hormone.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: adherens junction disassembly
description: The disaggregation of an adherens junction into its constituent components. An adherens junction is a cell-cell junction composed of the epithelial cadherin-catenin complex at which the cytoplasmic face of the plasma membrane is attached to actin filaments.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: focal adhesion disassembly
description: The disaggregation of a focal adhesion into its constituent components. A focal adhesion is a complex of intracellular signaling and structural proteins that provides a structural link between the internal actin cytoskeleton and the ECM, and also functions as a locus of signal transduction activity.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of focal adhesion disassembly
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of disaggregation of a focal adhesion into its constituent components.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of focal adhesion disassembly
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of a focal adhesion into its constituent components.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of protein localization to chromatin
synonyms: negative regulation of protein localisation to chromatin
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of protein localization to chromatin.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of protein localization to chromatin
synonyms: positive regulation of protein localisation to chromatin
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of protein localization to chromatin.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of bile acid secretion
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the controlled release of bile acid from a cell or a tissue.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of bile acid secretion
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the controlled release of bile acid from a cell or a tissue.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of bile acid secretion
description: Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the controlled release of bile acid from a cell or a tissue.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: tight junction assembly
synonyms: occluding cell junction assembly|occluding junction assembly
description: A cellular process that results in the aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a tight junction. A tight junction seals cells together in an epithelium in a way that prevents even small molecules from leaking from one side of the sheet to the other.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: tight junction organization
synonyms: occluding cell junction organization|occluding junction organization
description: A process that is carried out at the cellular level which results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts, or disassembly of a tight junction. A tight junction seals cells together in an epithelium in a way that prevents even small molecules from leaking from one side of the sheet to the other.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mucociliary clearance
description: The respiratory system process driven by motile cilia on epithelial cells of the respiratory tract by which mucus and associated inhaled particles and pathogens trapped within it are moved out of the airways.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: proacrosomal vesicle fusion
description: Fusion of the membrane of proacrosomal vesicle with the membrane of another proacrosomal vesicle to form the acrosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein localization to motile cilium
synonyms: protein localization to nonmotile primary cilium
description: A process in which a protein is transported to, or maintained in, a location within a motile cilium.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: olefinic compound metabolic process
synonyms: alkene substituted compound metabolic process|alkene substituted compound metabolism
description: The chemical reactions and pathways involving an olefinic compound, any compound which contains a carbon-carbon double bond (aka C=C).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of heterochromatin organization
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, extent or location of heterochromatin organization.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: sperm flagellum assembly
description: The assembly and organization of the sperm flagellum, the microtubule-based axoneme and associated structures that are part of a sperm flagellum (or cilium).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly
description: The assembly and organization of the sperm mitochondrial sheath, the tightly packed helical sheath of ATP-producing mitochondria restricted to the midpiece of the sperm flagellum.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lipid ubiquitination
description: The process in which one or more ubiquitin groups are added to a lipid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endothelial tube formation
description: The developmental process pertaining to the initial formation of an endothelial tube.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: glycosaminoglycan-protein linkage region biosynthetic process
synonyms: Glycosaminoglycan biosynthesis|linkage tetrasaccharide|glycosaminoglycan-protein linkage region biosynthesis
description: The formation of a tetrasaccharide linker sequence (xylose-galactose-galactose-glucuronate) on specific serine residues of a core protein, on to which dermatan sulfate, chondroitin sulfate, heparan sulfate or heparin glycosaminoglycans may be assembled to synthesise the corresponding proteoglycan.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: 2-oxoglutarate decarboxylation to succinyl-CoA
synonyms: 2-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase system|2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase system|2alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase system
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of succinyl-CoA from 2-oxoglutarate.  In most organisms, this pathway is part of the TCA cycle and comprises a series of three reactions carried out by a multisubunit complex called the '2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase complex', even though 2-oxoglutarate dehydrogenase activity describes only one of those reactions. The combination of the three reactions can be summarized as: 2-oxoglutarate + coenzyme A + NAD+ -> succinyl-CoA + CO2 + NADH.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: branched-chain alpha-keto acid decarboxylation to branched-chain acyl-CoA
synonyms: branched-chain 2-oxo acid dehydrogenase system|branched-chain alpha-keto acid dehydrogenase system
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of a branched-chain acyl-CoA by the oxidative decarboxylation of a branched-chain alpha-keto acid derived from L-leucine, L-isoleucine or L-valine. This pathway comprises a series of three reactions carried out by a multisubunit complex called the 'branched-chain alpha-keto acid dehydrogenase complex', even though branched-chain alpha-keto acid dehydrogenase activity describes only one of those reactions. The combination of the three reactions can be summarized as: 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate + coenzyme A + NAD+ -> branched-chain acyl-CoA + CO2 + NADH. Specific substrates include 3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate (a transamination product of L-valine), (S)-3-methyl-2-oxopentanoate (a transamination product of L-isoleucine) and 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoate (a transamination product of L-leucine), which generate the products 2-methylpropanoyl-CoA, 2-methylbutanoyl-CoA and 3-methylbutanoyl-CoA, respectively.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: GPI anchor remodelling
description: Any process leading to the modification of the GPI-anchor after its transfer and attachment to a protein.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: morula formation
description: The initial formation of a spherical embryonic mass of blastomeres formed before the blastula and resulting from cleavage of the fertilized ovum.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: L-aspartate import across plasma membrane
description: The directed movement of L-aspartate from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: meiotic nuclear division
description: One of the two nuclear divisions that occur as part of the meiotic cell cycle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitotic nuclear division
description: A mitotic cell cycle process comprising the steps by which the nucleus of a eukaryotic cell divides; the process involves condensation of chromosomal DNA into a highly compacted form. Canonically, mitosis produces two daughter nuclei whose chromosome complement is identical to that of the mother cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of cytoplasmic translational fidelity
description: Any process that modulates the ability of the cytoplasmic translational apparatus to interpret the genetic code.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial ADP transmembrane transport
description: The process in which ADP is transported across a mitochondrial membrane, into or out of the mitochondrion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular detoxification of methylglyoxal
description: Any process carried out at the cellular level that reduces or removes the toxicity of methylglyoxal. These may include chemical modification or transport of methylglyoxal away from sensitive areas and to compartments or complexes whose purpose is sequestration of the toxic substance.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lipid droplet formation
synonyms: adiposome formation|lipid body formation|lipid particle formation
description: A process that results in the assembly, arrangement of constituent parts of a lipid droplet.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cellular response to oxidised low-density lipoprotein particle stimulus
synonyms: cellular response to ox-LDL particle stimulus|cellular response to oxLDL particle stimulus|cellular response to oxidised LDL particle stimulus|cellular response to oxidized LDL particle stimulus|cellular response to oxidized low-density lipoprotein particle stimulus
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of an oxidized lipoprotein particle stimulus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: organelle localization by membrane tethering
description: The process by which an organelle membrane interacts with another membrane via molecular tethers that physically bridge the two membranes and attach them to each other.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: neuron projection arborization
synonyms: branching morphogenesis of a neurite|branching morphogenesis of a neuron projection|neurite arborization|neurite branching|neuron projection branching
description: The process in which the anatomical structures of a neuron projection are generated and organized into branches. A neuron projection is any process extending from a neural cell, such as axons or dendrites.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: dendrite arborization
description: The process in which the anatomical structures of a dendritic tree are generated and organized into dendritic branches.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: axon arborization
description: The process in which the terminal anatomical structures of an axon are generated and organized into branches of specialised projections, or boutons. An axon is the long process of a neuron that conducts nerve impulses, usually away from the cell body to the terminal branches.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: peptidyl-lysine crotonylation
description: The crotonylation of a lysine residue in a protein. Crotonyl is the univalent radical CH3-CH=CH-CO- derived from crotonic acid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: peptidyl-lysine butyrylation
description: The butyrylation of a lysine residue in a protein. Butyryl is the univalent radical C3H7COO- derived from butyric acid.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cardiac endothelial to mesenchymal transition
description: A transition where a cardiac endothelial cell loses apical/basolateral polarity, severs intercellular adhesive junctions, degrades basement membrane components and becomes a migratory mesenchymal cell. Endocardial cells (specialized endothelial cells that line the heart) undergo EndMT, and give rise to mesenchymal cells necessary for proper heart development. EndMT, specifically generates valve progenitor cells that give rise to the mitral and tricuspid valves. EndMT also contributes to endocardial cushion formation, as well as to generation of cardiac fibroblasts and smooth muscle cells, but not cardiac myocytes.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of lipoprotein transport
description: Any process that activates or increases the rate or extent of lipoprotein transport.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein storage
description: The accumulation and maintenance in cells of proteins. Protein reserves can be accumulated during early developmental stages for mobilization and utilization at later stages of development.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: interleukin-10-mediated signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by interleukin-10 binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: extracellular vesicle biogenesis
description: The assembly and secretion a set of components to form an extracellular vesicule, a membrane-bounded vesicle that is released into the extracellular region. Extracellular vesicles include exosomes, microvesicles and apoptotic bodies, based on the mechanism by which they are released from cells and differentiated based on their size and content.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: export across plasma membrane
description: The directed movement of some substance from inside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the extracellular region.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of Lewy body formation
description: Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of Lewy body formation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of lymphocyte chemotaxis
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of lymphocyte chemotaxis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: mitochondrial potassium ion transmembrane transport
description: The process in which a potassium ion is transported across a mitochondrial membrane, into or out of the mitochondrion.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: ammonium import across plasma membrane
description: The directed movement of an ammonium ion from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of pyruvate decarboxylation to acetyl-CoA
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of acetyl-CoA from pyruvate. In most organisms, this pathway links glycolysis to the TCA cycle, by a series of three reactions carried out by a multisubunit complex called the 'pyruvate dehydrogenase complex', even though pyruvate dehydrogenase activity describes only one of those reactions.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: dipeptide import across plasma membrane
description: The directed movement of a dipeptide from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: tripeptide import across plasma membrane
description: The directed movement of a tripeptide from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: apoptotic process in response to mitochondrial fragmentation
synonyms: apoptosis in response to mitochondrial fragmentation
description: Any apoptotic process that occurs as a result of mitochondrial fragmentation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of long-chain fatty acid import into cell
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of long-chain fatty acid import into a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of long-chain fatty acid import into cell
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of long-chain fatty acid import into a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: serotonin-gated cation-selective signaling pathway
synonyms: 5-HT-gated cation-selective signaling pathway|5-HT-gated cation-selective signalling pathway|5-hydroxytryptamine-gated cation-selective signaling pathway|5-hydroxytryptamine-gated cation-selective signalling pathway|serotonin-gated cation-selective signalling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by serotonin binding to a seratonin receptor on the surface of the target cell, followed by the movement of ions through a channel in the receptor complex. Ends with regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: translation at presynapse
description: Translation that occurs at the presynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: presynaptic endocytosis
description: A vesicle-mediated transport process in which the presynapse take up external materials or membrane constituents by the invagination of a small region of the plasma membrane to form a new membrane-bounded vesicle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: translation at postsynapse
description: Translation that occurs at the postsynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of translation at postsynapse
description: Any process that regulates translation occurring at the postsynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein catabolic process at postsynapse
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein at a postsynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation protein catabolic process at presynapse
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein at the presynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation protein catabolic process at postsynapse
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein at the postsynapse.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: repair of mitotic kinetochore microtubule attachment defect
synonyms: correction of mitotic kinetochore microtubule attachment defects|repair of mitotic kinetochore microtubule attachment defects
description: The mitotic cell cycle process where kinetochore microtubule attachment defects are corrected.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endoplasmic reticulum N-glycan trimming
description: The trimming, in the ER, of the protein newly attached N-glycan by glucosidases and mannosidases to produce high mannose-type N-glycans.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endosome fission
description: The process by which early and late endosomes undergo budding and fission reactions that separate regions destined for lysosomal degradation from carriers to be recycled to the plasma membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: peptidyl-serine ADP-deribosylation
description: The removal of ADP-ribose from ADP-ribosylserine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: peptidyl-glutamate ADP-deribosylation
description: The removal of ADP-ribose from ADP-ribosylglutamate.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endocytic iron import into cell
synonyms: iron import into cell by endocytosis
description: Uptake of iron into a cell via binding to an extracellular receptor, which is internalized by endocytosis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: serine import into mitochondrion
description: The process in which serine is transported from the cytosol into the mitochondrial matrix.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lysophospholipid translocation
description: The movement of a lysophospholipid molecule from one leaflet of a membrane bilayer to the opposite leaflet.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: aminophospholipid translocation
description: The movement of an aminophospholipid molecule from one leaflet of a membrane bilayer to the opposite leaflet.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: lipid export from cell
description: The directed movement of a lipid from a cell, into the extracellular region.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cyclic-GMP-AMP transmembrane import across plasma membrane
description: The directed movement of cyclic-GMP-AMP from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: antibacterial innate immune response
description: An defense response against a bacteria mediated through an innate immune response. An innate immune response is mediated by germline encoded components that directly recognize components of potential pathogens.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: antiviral innate immune response
description: A defense response against viruses mediated through an innate immune response. An innate immune response is mediated by germline encoded components that directly recognize components of potential pathogens.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cytokine precursor processing
description: The cleavage of a peptide bond in a precursor form of a cytokine, resulting in the mature (active) form of the cytokine.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: signaling receptor ligand precursor processing
description: The cleavage of a peptide bond in a precursor form of a signaling receptor ligand, resulting in the mature (active) form of the ligand.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein targeting to Golgi apparatus
description: The process of targeting specific proteins to the Golgi apparatus. Usually requires an organelle-specific protein sequence motif or a protein modification (for example a palmitoylation).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cytoplasm protein quality control
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of misfolded proteins in the cytoplasm, which are either targeted to cytoplasmic proteasomes for degradation or protected by chaperones to shield thermosensitive proteins from degradation until conditions allow disaggregation and refolding.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: response to Gram-positive bacterium
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus from a Gram-positive bacterium.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: response to Gram-negative bacterium
description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus from a Gram-negative bacterium.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: iron-sulfur cluster export from the mitochondrion
description: The directed movement of iron sulfur clusters from inside the mitochondrion into the cytosol by crossing the inner mitochondrial membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: integrated stress response signaling
description: The series of molecular signals generated in response to diverse stress stimuli required to restore cellular homeostasis. The core event in this pathway is the phosphorylation of eIF2 alpha by one of four members of the eIF2a kinase family (EIF2AK1/HRI, EIF2AK2/PKR, EIF2AK3/PERK and EIF2AK4/GCN2), which leads to a decrease in global protein synthesis and the induction of selected genes, including the transcription factor ATF4, that together promote cellular recovery.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: HRI-mediated signaling
description: A series of reactions in which a signal is passed on to downstream proteins within the cell via HRI (also known as EIF2AK1), an intracellular protein kinase that is activated by stress signals, such as heme deficiency, oxidative stress, osmotic shock, mitochondrial dysfunction and heat shock.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: GCN2-mediated signaling
synonyms: EIF2AK4-mediated signaling|regulation of eIF2 alpha phosphorylation by amino acid starvation
description: A series of reactions in which a signal is passed on to downstream proteins within the cell via GCN2 (also known as EIF2AK4), an intracellular protein kinase that is activated by stress signals, such as amino acid starvation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: 5-aminolevulinic acid import across plasma membrane
description: The directed movement of 5-aminolevulinic acid from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: very long-chain fatty acid beta-oxidation
description: A fatty acid beta-oxidation pathway acting on a very long-chain fatty acid. A very long-chain fatty acid has an aliphatic tail containing more than 22 carbons. The partway stars with the conversion of an acyl-CoA to a trans-2-enoyl-CoA, catalyzed by acyl-CoA oxidase; the electrons removed by oxidation pass directly to oxygen and produce hydrogen peroxide, which is cleaved by peroxisomal catalases. Fatty acid beta-oxidation begins with the addition of coenzyme A to a fatty acid, and ends when only two or three carbons remain (as acetyl-CoA or propionyl-CoA respectively).

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint signaling
description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of negative regulation of mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint signaling.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: regulation of reticulophagy
synonyms: regulation of ER autophagy|regulation of ER degradation|regulation of ER-phagy|regulation of autophagy of the ER|regulation of autophagy of the endoplasmic reticulum|regulation of endoplasmic reticulum autophagy|regulation of endoplasmic reticulum degradation
description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of reticulophagy.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of reticulophagy
synonyms: positive regulation of ER autophagy|positive regulation of ER degradation|positive regulation of ER-phagy|positive regulation of autophagy of the ER|positive regulation of autophagy of the endoplasmic reticulum|positive regulation of endoplasmic reticulum autophagy|positive regulation of endoplasmic reticulum degradation
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of reticulophagy.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: granzyme-mediated programmed cell death signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals induced by granzymes which triggers the cell death of a cell. The pathway starts with reception of a granzyme signal, and ends when the execution phase of cell death is triggered. Granzymes are serine proteases that are secreted by cytotoxic T cells and natural killer cells to induce cell death in target cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: piRNA transcription
description: The cellular synthesis of Piwi-interacting RNA piRNAs, a class of 24- to 30-nucleotide RNA derived from repeat or complex DNA sequence elements and processed by a Dicer-independent mechanism.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of piRNA transcription
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of the synthesis of piRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: defense response to symbiont
description: Reactions triggered in response to the presence of a symbiont that act to protect or prevent damage to the host.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: extraction of mislocalized protein from ER membrane
description: The removal of a mislocalized protein from the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: extraction of mislocalized protein from mitochondrial outer membrane
synonyms: extraction of mislocalized protein from outer mitochondrion membrane
description: The removal of a mislocalized protein from the mitochondrial outer membrane.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: ascorbate homeostasis
description: Any process involved in the maintenance of an internal steady state of ascorbate at the level of a cell.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: chromatin looping
synonyms: DNA loop extrusion|DNA looping|chromatin folding|chromatin loop assembly
description: A chromatin organization process that starts with the loading of an extrusion motor (by an SMC family complex) onto the chromatin, followed by chromatin extrusion that stops at loop anchoring sites on the chromosome.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: nuclear envelope budding
description: The process by which large macromolecular complexes are budded through the inner nuclear membrane, into the perinuclear space, thus acquiring a membrane envelope. The enveloped particle fuses with the outer nuclear membrane and is released into the cytoplasm.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process via the C-end degron rule pathway
description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of a protein or peptide covalently tagged with ubiquitin, via the DesCEND (destruction via C-end degron) pathway. In the DesCEND pathway, C-terminal residues (C-end degrons) in substrates are recognized by Cul2-RING and Cul4-RING E3 ligases, whereupon the substrates are linked to ubiquitin and then delivered to the proteasome for degradation. C-end degrons can be present in full-length proteins, truncated proteins or proteolytically cleaved forms.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: canonical inflammasome complex assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form an inflammasome complex.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: CARD8 inflammasome complex assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a CARD8 inflammasome complex.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of pyroptotic inflammatory response
description: Any process that increases the frequency, rate or extent of a pyroptotic inflammatory response.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: neutrophil extracellular trap formation
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a neutrophil extracellular trap, a network of extracellular fibers primarily composed of DNA from neutrophils, which bind and neutralizes pathogens.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of pre-B cell receptor expression
description: Any process that stops, prevents or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of the process leading up to expression of the pre-B cell receptor on the surface of pre-B cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: P450-containing electron transport chain
description: A electron transport chain in which one or more electron carriers operate to transfer electrons from donors to a cytochrome P450 protein or domain. Electron carriers operating in this chain include FAD-containing flavoproteins or domains, FMN domains, ferredoxins and cytochrome b5. The reduced cytochrome P450 functions as the terminal oxidase and participates in a wide range of biochemical pathways.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: radial glia-guided pyramidal neuron migration
description: The radial migration of a pyramidal neuron along radial glial cells.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: futile creatine cycle
description: The phosphorylation and dephosphorylation of creatine in a futile cycle, which dissipates the high energy charge of phosphocreatine as heat without performing any mechanical or chemical work. The futile creatine cycle takes place in thermogenic fat cells and is part of adaptive thermogenesis.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: positive regulation of oxytocin production
description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of production of oxytocin.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: transcription elongation-coupled chromatin remodeling
synonyms: DNA replication-independent chromatin organization|chromatin maintenance during transcription elongation|co-transcriptional chromatin reassembly|euchromatin maintenance during transcription elongation|maintenance of chromatin integrity during transcription elongation by RNAPII|maintenance of transcriptionally active chromatin during transcription elongation|transcription elongation coupled chromatin remodeling|transcriptional elongation-coupled chromatin remodeling
description: A chromatin remodeling process that reestablishes the chromatin structure following the passage of RNA polymerase II during transcription elongation, thus preventing cryptic transcription initiation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: membraneless organelle assembly
synonyms: non-membrane-bounded organelle assembly|non-membrane-bounded organelle formation|non-membrane-enclosed organelle assembly|non-membrane-enclosed organelle formation
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a non-membrane-bounded organelle.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: protein-containing complex localization to centriolar satellite
description: A protein-containing complex localization by which the complex is transported to, or maintained in, the centriolar satellite.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: CAT tailing
description: The C-terminal elongation of 60S-anchored stalled nascent polypeptide chains with untemplated alanine and threonine tails (CAT tails). CAT tails participate in the recognition of stalled nascent chains by the ribosome quality control system.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: facultative heterochromatin formation
description: The compaction of chromatin into a conformation that is refractory to transcription but that can be converted to euchromatin and allow transcription in specific contexts. These can be temporal (e.g., developmental states or specific cell-cycle stages), spatial (e.g., nuclear localization changes from the center to the periphery or vice versa due to exogenous factors/signals), or parental/heritable (e.g., monoallelic gene expression). In metazoa, this involves the methylation of histone H3K27, and in certain cases methylation of H3K9. On the other hand, in unicellular eukaryotes, only methylation of H3K9 is involved and H3K27 is not methylated.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: constitutive heterochromatin formation
description: The compaction of chromatin into heterochromatin, a conformation that is refractory to transcription and in that involves the methylation of histone H3K9. Constitutive heterochromatin cannot be converted back to euchromatin, the transcriptionally-active conformation.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: NLRP6 inflammasome complex assembly
description: The aggregation, arrangement and bonding together of a set of components to form a NLRP6 inflammasome complex.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: negative regulation of lncRNA transcription
description: Any process that decreases the frequency, rate or extent of the synthesis of a lncRNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: siRNA transcription
description: The transcription of a small interfering RNA from an RNA template.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: reorganization of cellular membranes to establish viral sites of replication
description: A process in intracellular membranes are reorganized by viral proteins that perturb membrane integrity and can cause an extensive rearrangement of cellular membranes, forming membranous webs, which are thought to be the site of replication or certain viruses, for example the HPV virus.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: interleukin-19-mediated signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by interleukin-19 binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: DNA repair-dependent chromatin remodeling
description: A chromatin remodeling process that allows DNA repair enzyme to access genomic DNA and repair DNA lesions.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: interleukin-22-mediated signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by interleukin-22 binding to its receptor on the surface of a target cell, and ending with the regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: zinc export across plasma membrane
description: The directed movement of zinc ions from a cell, into the extracellular region.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: DNA replication-dependent chromatin disassembly
description: The disruption of nucleosomes during DNA replication to allow the replication machinery to access the DNA.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: endolysosomal toll-like receptor signaling pathway
synonyms: endolysosomal pattern recognition receptor signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by a ligand binding to an endolysosomal pattern recognition receptor (PRR) of the toll-like family. PRRs bind pathogen-associated molecular pattern (PAMPs), structures conserved among microbial species.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cell surface toll-like receptor signaling pathway
description: The series of molecular signals initiated by a ligand binding to a cell surface pattern recognition receptor (PRR) of the toll-like family.

label: BiologicalProcess
name: cGAS/STING signaling pathway
